AI.method: MetaEns 包含离线元训练与在线选择两阶段。(1) 离线元训练：在带标签元数据集 M 上用 oracle-greedy 策略做轨迹展开，以 AP 提升定义真实边际增益 G(f|P)=AP(o_{P∪f},y)-AP(o_P,y)，收集"状态-增益"对；状态表示 φ 为固定 61 维分数级特征（三组 20 维块 + |P|），仅基于 Min-Max 归一化分数向量，包含 Pearson/尾部相关、Jaccard、峰度、熵、中心性、伪 AP/ROC、L2/余弦距离、same_family 等；由于正增益随集成增大而稀疏（零膨胀），采用两段式 hurdle 模型 Ĝ=f_cls·f_reg（分类器预测 P(G>0)，回归器仅在 G>0 上预测幅度），均用 ExtraTrees（对比 RF/XGBoost/LightGBM/MLP/线性模型最优）。家族划分 8 个算法族（IForest、LOF、kNN、HBOS、OCSVM、LODA、ABOD、COF），家族风险先验 π_F 取元训练 oracle 增益的 10% 分位数并取负部（未见家族置 0）。(2) 在线选择：先用 ELECT 选出主检测器，再按代理边际效用 ΔU=γ(f,P)·(Ĝ-λ_fam·π_F) 贪心扩展，γ=1/(1+β·sim_max) 用 top-k Jaccard 最大相似度做冗余折扣，sim_max 随集成单调不减故实现"次模启发"的边际递减；设置接受阈值 τ1（首个伙伴）与 τ2（迭代扩展），当无候选 ΔU>0 时自适应早停，预算 η 上限。集成聚合采用均值（消融优于 median/max/min）。复杂度 O(|Ω|²N + η|Ω|·C_inf)。
AI.result: 39 个 ADBench 表格数据集（n 129–49,097，d 4–1,555，污染率 0.03%–45.78%）：MetaEns AP 0.4308±0.0064、平均排名 59.3±6.96、ROC-AUC 0.7867、Prec@π 0.4042、Max-F1 0.4681、平均集成规模仅 2.2，全面优于 ELECT Top-10（AP 0.4117/10 模型）、MetaOD（0.3989）、Mega Ensemble（0.3970/297 模型）、IForest（0.3858）、LSCP（0.3484）及全部深度基线（DeepSVDD 0.2073 等），但仍低于有监督贪心 oracle 上界 0.6877。单侧 Wilcoxon 检验对所有基线显著（p≤0.039）。消融显示家族风险正则最关键（λ_fam=0 时 AP 降至 0.3995，ΔAP=-0.0359），其次为两段式模型（0.4133）与多样性折扣（0.4185）；oracle-greedy 轨迹优于 ε-greedy（0.4156）；元数据覆盖度单调增益（25%→0.3358，100%→0.4308）。敏感性与鲁棒性：β 几乎不敏感（方差<0.0005），风险分位数取 25%/50% 会严重退化（0.3368/0.3142）；更换任意主选择器（ELECT/LOF/IForest/随机）均能"救回"失败初值；t-SNE 与定量指标显示所选模型跨族分布（族数 2.2、Jaccard 0.36，优于 ELECT-10 的 0.68）；池规模在约 250 后饱和；扩充至含 13 个神经网络模型的 310 池仍稳健（AP 0.4122）；在 20 个 MVTec-AD 图像/文本特征集上迁移有效（总体 AP 0.4914，图像 0.6230，+0.0257 优于最佳基线）。失败模式：Glass、HeartDisease、Cardiotocography、Vertebral 等低维（5–13 维）数据集上弱于强单检测器。
AI.conclusion: MetaEns 证明"边际集成增益的结构可离线从带标签元数据学习"，从而在完全无标签条件下实现紧凑、跨族多样、风险可控的自适应集成构建，兼顾精度与计算成本（平均仅 2.2 个模型）。其关键设计——两段式增益建模、相似度折扣与家族级风险正则——均经消融验证为必要。局限：依赖带标签元数据且需预定义检测器到算法族的映射（对新检测器需领域知识）；仅面向批量静态数据，未处理流式/非平稳场景；在低维、单一检测器已近最优的数据集上集成收益有限。作者提出未来方向：更丰富的元表示以应对分布漂移、流式扩展、以及代理目标的理论化/不确定性量化版本。

title: Reducing Credit Assignment Variance via Counterfactual Reasoning Paths
summary: Reinforcement learning for multi-step reasoning with large language models (LLMs) often relies on sparse terminal rewards, leading to poor credit assignment conditions where the final feedback is evenly propagated across all intermediate decisions. This results in high gradient variance, unstable training, and numerous ineffective updates, ultimately causing the model to fail and preventing sustained improvement. We introduce a counterfactual comparison-based credit assignment framework, which samples multiple reasoning trajectories under the same input. By treating their differences as an implicit approximation of alternative decisions, we construct an implicit process-level advantage estimator that transforms sparse terminal rewards into step-sensitive learning signals. Based on this, we propose Implicit Behavior Policy Optimization (IBPO), which significantly improves training stability and performance upper bounds on mathematical and code reasoning benchmarks, pointing to a promising direction for unlocking the performance potential of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM强化学习训练中稀疏奖励导致的信用分配困难和高梯度方差问题，提出基于反事实对比的信用分配框架IBPO。通过在同一输入下采样多条轨迹并利用轨迹差异构造隐式优势估计，将终端奖励转化为步骤敏感的学習信号，有效提升了多步推理任务的训练稳定性和最终性能。
AI.motivation: 解决RL训练LLM多步推理任务时的信用分配问题。现有方法依赖稀疏的终端奖励，导致梯度方差高、训练不稳定、无效更新多，模型无法持续改进。
AI.method: 提出隐式行为策略优化(IBPO)，核心是构建隐式过程级优势估计器，通过对同一输入采样多条推理轨迹，利用轨迹间差异作为替代决策的隐式近似，从而实现细粒度的信用分配。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码推理基准测试中，显著提升了训练稳定性和性能上限。
AI.conclusion: IBPO通过将稀疏的终端奖励转化为步骤敏感的學習信號，显著提升了LLM多步推理的训练稳定性和性能上限，为解锁LLM的性能潜力提供了有前景的方向。

title: Approximate Distributed Coded Computing: Polynomial Codes and Randomized Sketching
summary: Coded computing is a distributed paradigm that uses coding theory to introduce \textit{redundancy} and overcome bottlenecks in large-scale systems. In the same vein, randomized numerical linear algebra employs probabilistic methods to \textit{compress} and accelerate linear algebraic operations, addressing challenges in high-dimensional data analysis. This article reviews the foundations of both fields and presents distributed schemes that combine techniques from both to speed up optimization and machine learning algorithms, in the presence of slow or non-responsive servers. Along the way, we touch on various related topics and mathematical concepts.

AI.tldr: This paper reviews two foundational fields—coded computing (which uses coding theory to introduce redundancy for overcoming system bottlenecks) and randomized numerical linear algebra (which uses probabilistic methods to compress and accelerate linear algebraic operations)—and proposes distributed schemes that combine both approaches to speed up optimization and machine learning algorithms, particularly in the presence of straggling servers.
AI.motivation: Large-scale distributed systems face bottlenecks and challenges in high-dimensional data analysis, including the presence of slow or non-responsive servers (stragglers).
AI.method: Hybrid approach integrating coded computing (redundancy mechanisms) with randomized numerical linear algebra (probabilistic compression techniques)
AI.result: Faster distributed optimization and machine learning algorithms compared to traditional approaches.
AI.conclusion: Distributed optimization and machine learning algorithms can be accelerated in the presence of stragglers/non-responsive servers by synergistically combining redundancy-based coding techniques with probabilistic compression methods.

title: LLM-based vs. Search-based Merge Conflict Resolution: An Empirical Study of Competing Paradigms
comment: Paper submitted to the Empirical Software Engineering Journal
summary:
Context: The resolution of software merge conflicts is being reshaped by two competing paradigms: generative approaches based on Large Language Models (LLMs) and optimization approaches from Search-Based Software Engineering (SBSE). While tools from both paradigms have shown promise, their relative strengths, weaknesses, and trade-offs are not yet well understood.
  Objective: This paper presents the first in-depth empirical study directly comparing these paradigms to identify their capabilities and limitations in real-world scenarios.
  Method: We evaluated MergeGen, a state-of-the-art LLM-based tool, against SBCR, a novel SBSE approach employing a Random Restart Hill Climbing (RRHC) algorithm. The comparison used thousands of real-world conflicts from open-source projects written in Java, C#, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  Results: Our findings reveal fundamental trade-offs. The LLM paradigm excels at resolving conflicts with imbalanced content by leveraging learned patterns. However, it struggles with non-English content and large inputs, which can lead to truncated or empty resolutions. Conversely, the SBSE paradigm demonstrates superior generalization across datasets and performs best on balanced conflicts, highlighting its potential as a robust, data-independent alternative.
  Conclusions: Neither paradigm is a silver bullet. Our findings highlight context-dependent strengths and motivate the development of hybrid systems that combine the complementary capabilities of LLM and SBSE approaches to create more robust and reliable merge conflict resolution tools.

AI.tldr: 首次实证研究直接比较LLM生成式与SBSE优化式两种软件合并冲突解决范式。研究发现LLM擅长处理不平衡冲突但受限于非英语和大输入场景，SBSE则在泛化能力和平衡冲突上占优。两种范式均非银弹，混合系统是未来发展方向。
AI.motivation: 软件合并冲突解决领域存在两种竞争范式（LLM生成式方法和SBSE优化方法），但它们的相对优势、局限性和权衡尚不清晰，亟需实证研究来明确各自的适用场景。
AI.method: 使用来自Java、C#、JavaScript和TypeScript开源项目的数千个真实冲突，对MergeGen（LLM方法）和SBCR（基于随机重启爬山算法的SBSE方法）进行直接对比评估。
AI.result: LLM范式在处理内容不平衡的冲突时表现优异（利用学习到的模式），但对非英语内容和大规模输入表现欠佳（可能产生截断或空解决方案）。SBSE范式在跨数据集泛化上更优，在平衡冲突处理上效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 混合系统是未来发展方向。LLM擅长处理内容不平衡的冲突，但处理非英语内容和大输入时表现不佳；SBSE在跨数据集泛化能力和平衡冲突处理上更优。两种范式各有适用场景，应结合各自优势构建更鲁棒的工具。

title: Online Graph Embedding in Star Graphs
summary: Graph embedding is a fundamental problem of mapping nodes of a guest graph into a host graph while minimizing the distance distortion, with broad applications, including virtual network embeddings into physical topologies, VLSI design, or community detection in social networks. However, in many real-world applications the guest graph changes over time and the embedding can adapt to these changes (e.g. virtual machine migration in network embeddings). Static embeddings are inherently inefficient in comparison to adaptive embeddings, but it remains an unresolved algorithmic challenge to design efficient embedding algorithms that adapt to the demand on-the-fly, i.e., that are online. In this paper, we derive optimal deterministic and randomized online algorithms for the online graph embedding problem in star host graphs. This is an essential building block on the way to design algorithms for more complex host graphs, representing a single node and its neighborhood. We start by presenting a $1.5$-competitive deterministic algorithm and showing that no deterministic algorithm can perform better. Our main contribution is a randomized algorithm that achieves a significantly better competitive ratio of $11/9 \approx 1.222$. Both the deterministic and the randomized algorithms are optimal, which we prove by deriving tight lower bounds for the competitiveness of any algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了星型（star）主机拓扑下在线图嵌入（动态图嵌入）问题，给出了最优的确定性算法（竞争比 3/2 = 1.5）与最优的随机化算法（竞争比 11/9 ≈ 1.222），并分别证明这两个竞争比不可改进。
AI.motivation: 图嵌入需要把客户图（guest graph）的节点映射到主机图（host graph）以最小化边拉伸（stretch）总和，应用于虚拟网络嵌入、VLSI 设计、社交网络社区发现等。但在许多真实场景中客户图会随时间变化（如虚拟机迁移），嵌入需要随之自适应。静态嵌入相比自适应嵌入本质上低效，而如何设计能"即时响应需求"的在线算法仍是未解决的算法难题。已有工作多聚焦于一般拓扑（容量受限团、直线链）上的在线图嵌入；星型拓扑作为"一个节点及其邻域"的基本构件，研究它可揭示与单节点请求类问题（list access、自调整 BST）本质不同的、成对请求的优化结构，是走向更复杂主机拓扑的关键基石。
AI.method: 问题模型：主机为 n 个节点的星型图，中心节点到任意节点距离为 1，其余两点距离为 2；客户图 n 个节点与主机一一对应构成一个构型；请求序列 σ 为客户节点对 {x_k, x_l}，逐个到达；每次请求按当前构型中两端距离付费（1 或 2），并可随时以代价 1 将某节点迁移到中心；目标是最小化服务代价与迁移代价之和，与知道未来的离线最优 OPT 比较竞争比。确定性算法 PivotTracking：维护候选集 C（跟踪某个最优离线算法 OPT* 可能位于中心的节点集合），请求与 C 相交时执行"交集行为"（C ← C ∩ σ_t，若中心不在 C 中则按固定顺序迁移），否则执行"并集行为"（C ← C ∪ σ_t）；OPT* 定义为在所有最优离线算法中按阶段长度逆字典序最小的那一个，由此证明算法的交集行为 ⟺ OPT* 对该请求付 1（廉价请求），并集行为 ⟺ OPT* 付 2（昂贵请求）；再把请求序列按正则表达式 Γ*(E+Γ+)*E* 分解为"块"，逐块给出 1.5 的界。随机化算法 Randomized PivotTracking：保持同一框架，交集行为中以均匀概率随机打破平局，并集行为中以各 1/3 概率"不迁移/迁移 x1/迁移 x2"；分析时把块进一步分为 simple 与 ambiguous 两类，结合候选集收缩次数与 1/3^ε 概率推导 11/9 的期望上界。下界方面：确定性下界用 3 个节点的星型拓扑构造序列，使任何确定性算法每请求至少付 2，而离线"迁移最高频节点"的代价至多 (4/3)|σ|，得 1.5；随机化下界构造两类请求模式（pattern 1: (a,x1),(a,x2)；pattern 2: (x1,x2),(a,x3)）的随机分布，取 p=2/3 分情况分析期望代价得每对请求 ≥ 11/3、离线每对付 3，再由 Yao 原理得 11/9（n ≥ 10）。
AI.result: 确定性：PivotTracking 算法竞争比为 1.5，且任何确定性算法竞争比不可能优于 1.5（该下界仅需 3 个物理节点即可达到），故最优。随机化：Randomized PivotTracking 算法在 oblivious 对手下竞争比为 11/9 ≈ 1.222，比确定性算法显著改善（多付出不超过约 22% 于离线最优代价）；由 Yao 原理导出的下界表明任何随机化算法竞争比不可能小于 11/9，故该算法同样最优。
AI.conclusion: 本文为星型主机拓扑下的在线（动态）图嵌入问题给出了确定性与随机化两套最优在线算法及其紧下界，是设计更复杂主机拓扑（star 可作为基本构件/单节点邻域的抽象）的算法基石。随机化带来的性能提升（1.5 → 1.222）说明在候选集出现二义性时随机打破平局是有价值的。未来工作方向是把这些技术推广到星型以外的网络拓扑（如树、网格等），并将在线嵌入方法用于自调整数据中心网络中的虚拟机/容器迁移与流量感知资源分配。

title: PyraVid: Hierarchical Multimodal Memory for Long-Horizon Video Reasoning
summary: Memory has become an increasingly important component of agentic systems, as these systems are expected to reason over long-term experience. However, prior work has largely focused on unimodal memory, leaving multimodal memory relatively underexplored despite its central role in real-world applications. Compared with unimodal settings, multimodal memory introduces additional challenges, including heterogeneous input integration, person-centric information alignment, and evidence aggregation across different granularities. We present PyraVid, a hierarchical multimodal memory framework inspired by Event Segmentation Theory from cognitive science. PyraVid organizes long videos into a coarse-to-fine pyramid structure, enabling structured memory access and effective evidence aggregation. It further supports structure-guided memory expansion with pruning, allowing the retrieval of related events with strong causal connectivity but low semantic similarity while reducing noise. Experiments on multiple long-video understanding benchmarks show that PyraVid consistently improves performance across datasets, model scales, and question types, highlighting the effectiveness of hierarchical multimodal memory for long-horizon reasoning.

AI.tldr: PyraVid是一个受认知科学启发的层次化多模态记忆框架，通过将长视频组织为金字塔结构并结合结构引导的扩展剪枝机制，解决了多模态记忆中的异构整合、对齐和证据聚合挑战，在长视频理解任务中展现了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统中的记忆研究主要集中于单模态场景，而多模态记忆因其在实际应用中的核心作用而被忽视。与单模态相比，多模态记忆面临异构输入整合、以人为中心的信息对齐以及不同粒度下的证据聚合等额外挑战，这些问题尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: PyraVid采用层次化多模态记忆框架，基于事件分割理论(Event Segmentation Theory)构建。核心设计包括：1) 将长视频组织为粗细粒度金字塔结构；2) 支持结构引导的记忆扩展与剪枝机制；3) 能够检索具有强因果关联但语义相似度低的相关事件，同时有效降低噪声干扰。
AI.result: 在多个长视频理解基准测试上的实验表明，PyraVid在数据集、模型规模和问题类型等多个维度上均实现了一致的性能提升，有效验证了层次化多模态记忆对长时推理的重要作用。
AI.conclusion: PyraVid通过认知科学启发的层次化记忆框架，为长视频推理任务提供了结构化的解决方案。实验证明，该方法在多个基准测试、多种模型规模和不同问题类型上均展现出一致的性能提升，验证了层次化多模态记忆对长时推理任务的有效性。

title: Generative AI and Two-Tiered Online Mental Health Communities
summary: Online mental health communities (OMHCs) are tiered platforms that connect patients with licensed counselors through public Q&A forums and paid private consultations. Their two-tier structure creates a strategic dilemma for genAI integration. Conversational agents can provide scalable and timely responses to a broader set of patients, alleviating persistent supply shortages, but their large-scale presence may also reshape counselors' participation in providing nuanced expertise, emotionally sensitive support, and paid consultations, which are central to platform revenue and long-run sustainability. Leveraging a quasi-natural experiment from the integration of a genAI-based conversational agent in a leading OMHC, we examine how AI entry affects counselor participation. Using multiple identification strategies, we find that posting intensity increases significantly after AI integration, while average response length remains unchanged and per-post social recognition declines. Mechanism analyses show that AI improves responsiveness and expands patient engagement, enlarging counselors' opportunity sets, with activity partially reallocated from a nearby non-AI subforum. Counselors respond heterogeneously: intrinsically motivated counselors reduce participation, whereas economically motivated counselors intensify competitive effort. These dynamics generate cross-tier spillovers: inactive counselors experience declines in paid consultations, while those who increase public participation preserve or expand downstream demand. Overall, our findings show that in tiered professional platforms, demand expansion and competitive incentives can outweigh intrinsic crowding-out.

AI.tldr: 研究 genAI 集成对在线心理健康社区（OMHC）中 counselor 参与的影响。发现 AI 虽可能产生内在挤出效应，但通过扩大需求和激发竞争激励，整体上增加了 counselor 的 posting intensity。关键在于 counselor 异质性响应和 cross-tier 效应，为分层专业平台的 AI 整合策略提供了重要启示。
AI.motivation: OMHCs 具有两层结构（公共论坛 + 付费私人咨询），genAI 集成产生战略困境：AI 可扩大患者覆盖并缓解供给短缺，但可能重塑 counselor 在提供 nuanced expertise、emotionally sensitive support 和 paid consultations 中的角色，进而影响平台收入和长期可持续性。
AI.method: 使用一家领先 OMHC 中 genAI 对话式 agent 集成的准自然实验，采用多种识别策略，分析 posting intensity、response length、social recognition 等指标，并通过机制分析和异质性分析探索影响路径。
AI.result: AI 集成后：posting intensity 显著增加；平均响应长度不变；per-post social recognition 下降。机制：AI 提升响应性、扩大患者参与度，增大 counselor 机会集，活动部分从邻近非 AI 子论坛转移。Counselor 响应异质：内在动机者减少参与，经济动机者加强竞争性努力。Cross-tier spillovers：不活跃者 paid consultations 下降，增加公开参与者维持或扩大下游需求。
AI.conclusion: 在分层专业平台上，需求扩展和竞争激励可以抵消AI对 counselor 的内在挤出效应。Counselor 对 AI 集成的响应具有异质性：内在动机型 counselor 减少参与，而经济动机型 counselor 则加强竞争性努力。Cross-tier spillovers 明显：不活跃的 counselor paid consultations 下降，而增加公开参与的 counselor 则维持或扩大下游需求。

title: LERA: LLM-Enhanced RAG for Ad Auction in Generative Chatbots
summary: The integration of advertising auction mechanisms into large language model (LLM)-based chatbots presents a significant opportunity for commercialization, yet poses unique challenges in balancing relevance, efficiency, and user experience. Recently, Feizi et al.~\citep{feizi2023online} and Hajiaghayi et al.~\citep{hajiaghayi2024ad} outlined a retrieve-then-generate paradigm that decouples retrieval and generation, offering lightweight ad insertion and payment determination. However, current retrieval relies solely on text embedding similarity, which may lead to commercial misinterpretation and issues such as repetitive insertions. In this paper, we propose LERA, a two-stage retrieve-then-generate auction framework tailored for LLM chatbots. In the first stage, embedding-based coarse filtering pre-selects a small set of candidate advertisers. In the second stage, the LLM itself is queried with a carefully designed prompt to produce logits over candidates, which serve as refined organic relevance scores. These scores are combined with bids, and a critical-value payment rule accounts for both the coarse-filtering and fine-ranking thresholds, ensuring truthfulness for utility-maximizing advertisers. The framework naturally extends to multiple ad insertions within dynamic dialogue flows and long responses. Experiments on a synthetic advertiser-query benchmark show that LERA substantially improves ad selection accuracy and insertion diversity while incurring only controllable latency overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LERA框架，将广告拍卖机制融入LLM聊天机器人，采用嵌入过滤+LLM精细排序的两阶段架构解决广告选择问题，并设计关键值支付规则确保真实性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM聊天机器人的广告插入方案存在缺陷：仅依赖文本嵌入相似度导致商业误判和重复插入，难以平衡相关性、效率和用户体验。
AI.method: 第一阶段：基于嵌入的粗过滤预选少量候选广告；第二阶段：利用精心设计的提示查询LLM生成候选者的logits作为精细相关性分数；结合出价和关键值支付规则（考虑粗过滤和细排序阈值）确保真实性。框架支持动态对话流和多广告插入。
AI.result: 在合成广告主-查询基准测试中，LERA显著提升广告选择准确性和插入多样性，延迟开销可控。
AI.conclusion: LERA为LLM聊天机器人广告拍卖提供了有效解决方案，平衡了广告主效用、用户体验和平台收益。

title: Beyond Sentiment Classification: A Generative Framework for Emotion Intensity Evaluation in Text
summary:
We introduce a novel approach to emotion modeling that shifts the focus from
  identification to evaluation, addressing the limitations of discrete classification in
  applied domains such as finance. By constructing a dataset of emotional intensity
  scores and fine-tuning open-weight generative language models to output continuous
  values from 0-100, we demonstrate a more expressive, generalizable framework for
  sentiment and emotion analysis. Our findings not only outperform classification
  baselines but also reveal surprising generalization capabilities and transfer effects
  to related constructs such as sentiment and arousal. This work contributes to the
  interdisciplinary recontextualization of NLP by introducing emotion intensity
  evaluation as an alternative to classification, arguing that this shift better aligns
  with the needs of domains--such as finance--where the degree of emotional content is
  central to interpretation and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将情感建模从分类转向评估，通过构建情感强度分数数据集并微调开源生成式语言模型输出0-100的连续值，实现比传统分类方法更好的性能和泛化能力，尤其适用于金融等领域。
AI.motivation: Addresses limitations of discrete emotion classification in applied domains (e.g., finance), where the intensity/degree of emotional content is more relevant than categorical identification.
AI.method: Constructing a dataset of emotional intensity scores (0-100) and fine-tuning open-weight generative language models to output continuous values.
AI.result: Outperforms classification baselines, demonstrates surprising generalization capabilities and transfer effects to related constructs such as sentiment and arousal.
AI.conclusion: Introduces emotion intensity evaluation as an alternative paradigm to classification, particularly suited for domains like finance where the degree of emotional content is central to interpretation and decision-making.

title: IVF-TQ: Streaming-Robust Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search via a Codebook-Free Residual Layer
summary: We propose IVF-TQ, an IVF index with a codebook-free residual layer: a fixed random rotation followed by precomputed Lloyd-Max scalar quantization depending only on (b, d). Only the IVF coarse partition is trained. Building on TurboQuant (Zandieh et al., 2025), the design substantially reduces a key failure mode of trained-codebook ANN indexes (PQ, OPQ, ScaNN): staleness under streaming ingestion.Empirical (3 seeds): Per-batch PQ retraining does not recover the streaming gap at any tested bit budget (paired-t p > 0.28 everywhere). On streaming Deep-10M, IVF-TQ holds at 87.4% -> 86.6% (Delta = -0.80 +/- 0.10pp) while IVF-PQ degrades -3.23pp. A shuffled-i.i.d. control on SIFT-1M shows IVF-PQ losing -3.9pp without distribution shift. At higher PQ bit budgets (~1.5x IVF-TQ memory), absolute recall favors PQ as expected from rate-distortion (+6.1pp Deep-10M; +2.0pp SIFT-10M); the durable IVF-TQ benefit is operational (no codebook to retrain), robust across memory regimes.Prior art: IVF around a codebook-free residual quantizer is architecturally not new -- IVF-RaBitQ ships in Milvus, cuVS, LanceDB, Weaviate; Shi et al. (2026) is concurrent GPU work. TurboQuant itself tests only flat-rotation ANN.Contributions: (i) A multi-seed streaming-operational story for codebook-free IVF: 10M-scale evidence across PQ memory budgets. (ii) A uniform-over-sphere IP-error bound for the TQ residual quantizer with one fixed rotation (proof sketch in v1; rigorous in v2). (iii) Adaptive IVF-TQ: a partition-only refresh recovering 67% -> 97.8% under worst-case rotation shift with re-ranking (90.3% without).Code, data: https://github.com/tarun-ks/turboquant_search

AI.tldr: IVF-TQ是一种无需码本的残差量化索引方法，通过固定随机旋转和预计算的Lloyd-Max标量量化解决流式ANN场景下训练码本方法的过期性问题。实验表明该方法在流式数据下保持稳定性能(-0.80pp退化 vs PQ的-3.23pp)，且无需重新训练码本，并提供理论上的球面IP误差界保证。
AI.motivation: 解决训练码本ANN索引(PQ, OPQ, ScaNN)在流式数据摄取下的"过期性"问题——当新数据流入时，训练好的码本变得过时。现有方法需要重新训练码本，这在流式场景中代价高昂。
AI.method: IVF-TQ uses a codebook-free residual layer: fixed random rotation + precomputed Lloyd-Max scalar quantization (parameters depend only on bit budget b and dimensionality d). Only the IVF coarse partition is trained. The method builds on TurboQuant and includes an Adaptive IVF-TQ variant with partition-only refresh that can recover performance under worst-case rotation shift through re-ranking.
AI.result: 在流式Deep-10M上，IVF-TQ保持87.4%→86.6%(-0.80pp)，而IVF-PQ退化-3.23pp；SIFT-1M上无分布偏移时IVF-PQ也丢失-3.9pp。PQ在高内存预算下绝对召回率更高(Deep-10M +6.1pp; SIFT-10M +2.0pp)。自适应IVF-TQ在最坏情况旋转偏移下可恢复67%→97.8%。
AI.conclusion: IVF-TQ provides a practical solution for streaming ANN scenarios where trained codebook methods fail. While PQ shows higher absolute recall at higher memory budgets, IVF-TQ offers operational durability and robustness across memory regimes. The adaptive partition-only refresh mechanism effectively recovers performance under distribution shift.

title: SignMuon: Communication-Efficient Distributed Muon Optimization
summary:
Distributed training of large neural networks is bottlenecked by full-precision gradient communication and by coordinatewise optimizers that ignore the matrix structure of weight tensors. We propose Sign-Muon, a 1-bit, matrix-aware optimizer that combines majority-vote sign aggregation from signSGD with the polar-step framework of Muon. Each worker forms a Muon-style direction by taking the polar factor of its momentum via a Newton--Schulz iteration, transmits only the entrywise signs, and aggregates by majority vote; an optional local polar step further enforces orthogonality at no extra communication cost.
  Under spectral-norm smoothness and bounded-variance stochastic gradients, the spectral-norm normalized sign step yields an $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ nonconvex rate for an $\ell_1$-based stationarity measure. With unimodal symmetric noise, majority vote across $M$ workers cuts the stochastic term by $1/\sqrt{M}$, matching signSGD. In the $α$-$β$ model, distributed Sign-Muon needs only one integer sum-allreduce per iteration; all orthogonalization is local, giving a $32\times$ bandwidth reduction over float32 ($4\times$ for int8).
  Across 330 CIFAR-10/ResNet-50 configurations Sign-Muon attains the best validation accuracy (92.15\%); its 4-GPU majority-vote variant reaches 92.02\% with 37\% less training time at matched effective batch. On nanoGPT, Sign-Muon achieves lower perplexity and better anytime performance than other sign-based baselines, with favorable weak-scaling up to 16 GPUs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sign-Muon，一种1比特、矩阵感知的分布式优化器，结合signSGD的符号聚合与Muon的极坐标步框架。通过Newton-Schulz迭代计算极因子，仅传输符号位，多数投票聚合，实现32倍带宽压缩。理论证明在谱范数平滑假设下达O(1/√T)收敛速率，实验在CIFAR-10/ResNet-50和nanoGPT上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 分布式大模型训练的通信瓶颈：全精度梯度通信开销大，且现有坐标式优化器忽略权重矩阵结构信息。
AI.method: 提出Sign-Muon优化器，融合signSGD的符号聚合与Muon的极坐标步框架。核心思想：各worker通过Newton-Schulz迭代计算动量的极因子形成Muon风格方向，仅传输逐元素符号位，通过多数投票聚合，且可选的局部极坐标步可无额外通信成本地保证正交性。理论分析基于谱范数平滑和方差有界随机梯度，在ℓ1平稳性测度下达到O(1/√T)非凸收敛速率，多worker多数投票可按1/√M缩减随机项。
AI.result: Sign-Muon相比现有方法有显著优势：通信效率上仅需一次整数sum-allreduce，带宽压缩32倍；CIFAR-10/ResNet-50上达最高验证精度92.15%；nanoGPT上困惑度更低、随时性能更优；具有良好的弱扩展性。
AI.conclusion: Sign-Muon是一种极具竞争力的分布式训练优化器，仅需一次整数sum-allreduce通信即可完成迭代，相比float32实现32倍带宽压缩（int8下为4倍）。在CIFAR-10/ResNet-50上取得最佳验证精度92.15%，4-GPU版本达92.02%且训练时间减少37%。在nanoGPT上展现更低困惑度和更优的随时性能，并具有良好的弱扩展性（支持16 GPU）。

title: GoodServe: Towards High-Goodput Serving of Agentic LLM Inferences over Heterogeneous Resources
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) play a critical role in emerging agentic applications, where the timely completion of each entire inference is critical. Meanwhile, agentic LLM inferences are increasingly served on heterogeneous GPUs in operator's resource pools. Therefore, it is crucial to route incoming inference requests to appropriate GPUs so that their end-to-end latency requirements are satisfied whenever possible, thereby achieving high goodput. In this paper, we propose GoodServe, a goodput-optimized serving system for agentic inferences over heterogeneous resources. GoodServe performs inference routing in a predict-and-rectify manner. It estimates the request output lengths as well as the GPU serving status in an accurate and also practical manner. Based on information from both the demand and resource sides, it then makes high-quality routing decisions using a just-enough instance selection heuristic. It also periodically monitors SLO-violation risks of active requests and triggers runtime request migrations to address unexpected dynamics. Our evaluations show that GoodServe improves goodput by up to 27.4% over existing routing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对异构GPU环境下LLM智能体推理的服务质量问题，提出GoodServe系统，通过预测-纠正路由机制和运行时迁移策略优化服务吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 在大语言模型(LLM)驱动的智能体应用中，每个推理请求的及时完成至关重要；同时，智能体LLM推理正越来越多地运行在运营商资源池中的异构GPU上。因此，需要将推理请求路由到合适的GPU，在满足端到端延迟要求的前提下实现高吞吐量(goodput)。
AI.method: GoodServe采用"预测-纠正"推理路由方法：(1)准确估算请求输出长度和GPU服务状态；(2)基于需求侧和资源侧信息，使用"刚好足够实例选择"启发式算法做高质量路由决策；(3)周期监控活跃请求的SLO违规风险，触发运行时请求迁移应对突发动态。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，GoodServe相比现有路由方法可将吞吐量提升最高27.4%。
AI.conclusion: GoodServe在异构GPU环境下显著提升了智能体推理的吞吐量，通过预测-纠正机制和运行时迁移策略，有效平衡了资源利用率与服务延迟SLO要求。

title: Optimizing an IDE for an Evolving Language Ecosystem
summary: This paper describes a strategy for developing a high performance and feature-rich IDE for an evolving smart contract language ecosystem. Our target is Move, a programming language for the Sui smart contracts platform. The strategy we chose to support the Move language ecosystem utilizes Language Server Protocol (LSP) and it is based on the already existing "core" language machinery, in particular the core language compiler. We discuss alternatives we considered, as well as the evolution of our infrastructure that was necessary to keep up with the growth of the language ecosystem, particularly with respect to optimizations (and their impact) that needed to be implemented to accommodate this growth. We conclude with lessons learned during the IDE support development process that we hope will be beneficial for others attempting to follow a similar path.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了为 Move 智能合约语言开发高性能 IDE 的策略，采用 LSP 协议并基于核心编译器基础设施，同时讨论了为适应语言生态系统增长而进行的优化和经验教训。
AI.motivation: 为 Sui 平台上不断发展的 Move 智能合约语言生态系统提供高质量的 IDE 支持
AI.method: 采用语言服务器协议(LSP)，基于现有核心语言编译器基础设施进行开发
AI.result: 成功开发了高性能、功能丰富的 IDE，并完成了必要的优化以适应生态系统增长
AI.conclusion: 总结了 IDE 开发过程中的经验教训，为其他采用类似路径的开发者提供参考

title: Iterative Chow Filtering for Learning with Distribution Shift
summary:
Recent work due to Goel et al. gave the first efficient algorithms for learning with distribution shift in the challenging PQ framework. In this setting, a learner receives labeled training examples, unlabeled test examples, and must make correct predictions on the test set but is allowed to abstain from predicting on out-of-distribution points. Their results rely on ${\cal L}_2$ sandwiching approximations, a strong requirement that leads to poor bounds for several basic function classes such as DNF formulas.
  Here, we show that the weaker notion of ${\cal L}_1$ sandwiching suffices for efficient PQ learning. As a consequence, we obtain the first quasipolynomial-time PQ learning algorithm for DNFs under the uniform distribution and essentially match the guarantees known for ordinary PAC learning. More broadly, our bounds provide exponential improvements for several classes including constant depth circuits and constant degree polynomial threshold functions.
  Our main technical ingredient is Iterative Chow Filtering, a new procedure that uses low-degree Chow parameters to identify and remove test points incompatible with the training distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"迭代 Chow 滤波"（Iterative Chow Filtering, ICF）这一新的离群点过滤过程，用以证明比已有工作更弱的 ℒ₁ 夹逼（sandwiching）即可支撑高效的 PQ 学习（分布偏移下的选择性预测学习）。核心贡献包括：①提出乘法型 Chow 迁移引理与 ICF 算法，实现从 ℒ₁ 夹逼到 PQ 所需"点选择性覆盖"保证的转换；②证明存在 (ε,δ,η)-PQ 学习器，样本复杂度与运行时间为 poly((d+1)^ℓ, A^ℓ, 1/ε, 1/η, log(1/δ)^ℓ)，其中 ℓ = ℒ₁(𝒞,𝒟, εη/8)；③首次给出均匀分布下 DNF 的准多项式时间 PQ 学习算法（d^{O(log²s)}，此前最好为 d^{Õ(√s)}），并对常数深度电路、常数次数多项式阈值函数、度-2 PTF、常数个半空间函数的复合带来指数级改进；④同时给出更精细的选择性误差保证 λ_test+(λ_train+opt_train)/η+ε，并在白盒分析下把 ℒ₁ 夹逼推进到"宽容 TDS 学习"。
AI.motivation: 分布偏移（domain adaptation）下高效算法的保证长期停留在信息论层面。为刻画"可拒答"的可靠性学习，Goldwasser 等人提出 PQ 学习框架：学习者只拿到带标签的训练样本与无标签的测试样本，允许对分布外点弃权，但被接受的测试点上必须预测正确。Goel 等人给出了首批 PQ 学习的高效算法，但其技术核心是 ℒ₂ 夹逼（要求上下夹逼多项式的"间隙平方"期望很小）并要求夹逼多项式系数有界，这一条件很强：对 DNF 等基本函数类，已知 ℒ₂ 夹逼次数比普通多项式逼近的次数在指数意义上更差，导致均匀分布下 DNF 的 PQ 学习此前连次指数时间算法都没有，且常数深度电路、PTF 等类的运行时间界也很差。另一方面，已有 TDS 学习结果（Chandrasekaran 等）只证明了 ℒ₁ 夹逼足够，且用的是"加性 Chow 参数匹配"这一在 PQ 框架下根本不可行的条件（因为任意合法 selector 都不可能让筛选后的测试分布与训练分布 Chow 匹配）。因此本文的核心动机是：(1) 证明更弱的 ℒ₁ 夹逼已足以支撑高效 PQ 学习；(2) 给出新的误差迁移条件（乘法型 Chow 支配）以替代不可行的加性匹配；(3) 设计可高效实现该条件的过滤算法。
AI.method: 方法分为三部分。(1) 误差迁移引理（Lemma 4.1，Chow Transfer）：设 f* 是联合最优假设，p_down ≤ f* ≤ p_up 是其 ℒ₁ 夹逼多项式；若在筛选后的测试分布上，Chow 型期望 E[ f̂·p̄_down·s ] 与 E[ f̄̂·p_up·s ] 分别被训练分布上对应量的 R 倍乘性支配，则被接受测试点上的误差被界定为 λ_test + R(λ_train + err_train(f̂)) + ε。(2) Iterative Chow Filtering（Algorithm 1/2，Theorem 3.1/B.1）：输入分类器族 ℱ（取 {f̂, 1−f̂}）、训练样本 S、测试样本 S′、次数 ℓ、乘性松弛 R、方差界 β；先做有界化预处理剔除 f(x)|p(x)|>B 的点；随后迭代求解凸规划 max_{f∈ℱ,p∈𝒫(f)} (1/|S′|)Σ_{x∈S_{i−1}} f(x)p(x)，其中 𝒫(f) 由二次方差约束与线性期望约束定义；若最优值 ≤ ε 则终止并输出 selector s(x)=1{有界条件}·Π 1{f_i*(x)|p_i*(x)| ≤ τ_i*}，否则选取阈值 τ 使被剔除的测试质量至少是训练质量 R 倍，剔除该部分测试点并迭代。与先前基于边缘分布多项式期望差异的过滤（IPF、Goel 等的谱离群点剔除）不同，ICF 用"被学习到的布尔假设加权的 Chow 期望"作为过滤判据。证明要点：尾和公式（Prop B.1）保证阈值存在；每轮至少剔除 Δ|S′| 个点，故迭代次数 t ≤ ⌊1/Δ⌋（Prop B.2）；由此 selector 落在 VC 维为 O((d+1)^ℓ ℓ log d log k) 的类中（Lemma E.4），再用一致收敛（Lemma E.5，Marcinkiewicz–Zygmund + Hölder）把样本统计推回总体；最终拒答率 ≤ (1+ε)/R，且额外得到 ≤ (d_TV+ε)/(R−1) 的界。(3) PQ 学习算法：先用 ℒ₁ 多项式回归（Goel et al. 的 Theorem E.1）从训练样本学得 f̂（训练误差 ≤ opt_train + εη/2），再对 (f̂, 训练边缘样本, 测试边缘样本) 运行 ICF 得到 selector s，取 R′=1/η+ε/96、β=4(2A)^{2ℓ}、ε′=εη/96，输出 (f̂, s)。分析中用到超契约性（hypercontractive）假设以保证多项式集中，以及夹逼多项式的非负性与二阶矩界 E[p_up²] < 4(2A)^{2ℓ}。
AI.result: 主定理（Theorem 4.1 / C.1）：若训练边缘 𝒟 是 A-超契约的，且 𝒞 关于 𝒟 的 ℒ₁ 夹逼次数 ℓ = ℒ₁(𝒞,𝒟,εη/8)，则存在 (ε,δ,η)-PQ 学习器，样本复杂度与运行时间 poly((d+1)^ℓ, A^ℓ, 1/ε, 1/η, log(1/δ)^ℓ)；保证为：被接受的测试点上误差 ≤ λ_test + (λ_train + opt_train)/η + ε，且训练边缘下拒答率 ≤ η。这比 Goel 等人的 O(λ/η) 型保证更精细（领先项无常数损失），即使对高斯训练边缘下的线性分隔器 PQ 学习也改进了已知最好误差保证。具体类别的运行时间改进（表 1）：均匀分布下 DNF（大小 s）：d^{O(log²s)}，此前 d^{Õ(√s)}，为该设定下首个准多项式时间 PQ 学习算法，基本追平普通 PAC 学习的保证；均匀分布下大小 s、深度 t 电路：d^{(log s)^{O(t)}}，此前（仅限公式类）d^{√s (log s)^{O(t)}}；度-2 PTF：poly(d)，此前 2^{O(d)}；高斯下常数次数 PTF：poly(d)，此前 2^{poly(d)}；各向同性对数凹分布下常数个半空间函数的任意函数：poly(d)，此前无结果。宽容 TDS 学习方面（Appendix D）：直接白盒调用 ICF 的 TDS 学习器达到误差 λ_test + R(λ_train+opt_train) + Rθ/(R−1) + ε，取 R = 1+max{√(θ/2), ε/9} 得误差 λ + opt_train + 4√θ + ε、容差 θ，从而 ℒ₁ 夹逼首次足以支撑宽容 TDS 学习。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：弱化的 ℒ₁ 夹逼（仅要求上下夹逼多项式间隙的一阶期望小，且不需系数有界）已足以支撑高效的 PQ 学习；关键在于用"基于 Chow 参数的乘法型比较"取代不可行的加性 Chow 匹配，并结合新的 Iterative Chow Filtering 离群点过滤机制把 ℒ₁ 夹逼转化为 PQ 所需的选择性覆盖保证。这在计算复杂度上弥合了 PQ 学习与普通 PAC 学习在 DNF（均匀分布）上的差距，并在多个函数类上取得指数级改进，同时把分布偏移下"误差—拒答率"权衡的保证提升到已知最优形式。局限与未来工作：结论依赖"存在关于超契约训练分布的 ℒ₁ 夹逼"这一假设，该条件是否为高效 PQ 学习的必要条件仍属开放问题；误差界虽在某些特例（含 Goldwasser 等人的构造）中紧致，但是否能在其他特例中进一步改进（包括计算上低效的算法）尚不清楚。

title: Multi-LLM Systems Exhibit Robust Semantic Collapse
comment: 64 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables; includes Supplementary Information
summary: Whether machines can originate novel content has been debated for nearly two centuries, from Lovelace's assertion that no engine can "originate anything" to Turing's question of whether a machine can amplify ideas brought in from outside. Multi-large language model (LLM) systems, increasingly deployed for autonomous generation, reopen this question empirically. Here we show that such systems, operating in closed loops, exhibit semantic collapse: systematic convergence in semantic representations despite apparent lexical variation. Across model families, extended simulations of 200 to 1,000 rounds, the pattern remains consistent. Twelve intervention strategies, spanning decoding parameters, prompt design, agent composition, activation engineering, and reinforcement learning, fail to restore semantic diversity. Mechanistic analyses suggest that semantic collapse is not explained by alignment or conformity biases, but is consistent with intrinsic properties of autoregressive generation. Our results point to fundamental constraints in the ability of multi-LLM systems to sustain open-ended knowledge production in closed-loop settings.

AI.tldr: 多大型语言模型(LLM)系统在闭环运行中会出现语义坍缩现象，即尽管词汇层面存在变化，但语义表征趋于系统性收敛。研究通过对多个模型家族进行200至1000轮的扩展模拟，发现这一模式一致存在。12种干预策略（涵盖解码参数、提示设计、智能体组合、激活工程和强化学习）均未能恢复语义多样性。机制分析表明，语义坍缩并非源于对齐或conformity偏差，而与自回归生成的内在特性一致。
AI.motivation: 自Ada Lovelace提出机器无法"原创任何内容"以来，机器能否产生新颖内容已争论近两个世纪。多LLM系统日益被部署用于自主生成内容，这重新引发了关于机器创造性本质的实证问题。
AI.method: 跨模型家族进行200至1000轮扩展模拟的闭环实验；测试12种干预策略（解码参数调整、提示设计、智能体组合、激活工程、强化学习）；进行 mechanistic 分析以探究根本原因。
AI.result: 多LLM系统在闭环中表现出语义坍缩——尽管词汇有变化，语义表征系统性收敛；12种干预策略均无法恢复语义多样性；语义坍缩与对齐或conformity偏差无关，而与自回归生成的内在特性一致。
AI.conclusion: 多LLM系统在闭环环境中维持开放式知识生产的能力存在根本性限制；自回归生成机制可能是导致语义坍缩的根本原因。

title: Beyond Imperfect Alternatives with Rulemapping: A Neuro-Symbolic Case Study on Online Hate Speech
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at ICAIL 2026. 10 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables
summary: Automating legal reasoning forces a choice between imperfect alternatives: symbolic systems offer transparency but struggle with ambiguity, whereas neural systems handle natural language flexibly but lack verifiability. This paper investigates whether a hybrid, neuro-symbolic approach can reconcile this trade-off. We evaluate this architecture in the domain of online content moderation, which serves as a proxy for high-volume legal decision-making such as mass administrative proceedings. In these settings, operators must assess thousands of cases daily under strict legal standards. Specifically, we examine whether constraining large language models (LLMs) within deterministic symbolic scaffolds improves statute-grounded illegality assessment while preventing "scope drift" (where LLMs conflate moral offensiveness with legal illegality). We evaluate the neuro-symbolic variant of Rulemapping - a visual logic-tree method that operationalises the classic legal syllogism - on online hate-speech classification under §130(1) of the German Criminal Code. Across diverse LLMs, Rulemapping maintains high recall (0.82-0.89) while achieving precision of 0.80-0.86, compared to 0.34-0.49 for unconstrained prompting. Expert-authored symbolic scaffolds thus enable robust legal automation aligned with regulatory requirements for auditability and verifiable decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经符号混合方法（Rulemapping），通过将大语言模型约束在专家编写的确定性符号框架内，实现可审计的法律推理自动化。在德国刑法§130条仇恨言论分类任务中，该方法在保持高召回率（0.82-0.89）的同时，将精确率从无约束提示的0.34-0.49提升至0.80-0.86，有效解决了LLM将道德冒犯与法律违法性混淆的"范围漂移"问题。
AI.motivation: 解决法律推理自动化中长期存在的透明度与灵活性之间的权衡困境。传统符号系统虽可验证但难以处理自然语言歧义，神经模型虽灵活但缺乏可审计性。此外，在大规模内容审核场景中，LLM易产生"范围漂移"——将道德 offensiveness 与法律 illegality 混淆，需要一种能严格遵循法律标准的方法。
AI.method: 采用Rulemapping方法——一种将经典法律三段论操作化的视觉逻辑树方法。具体实现为：将LLM约束在专家编写的确定性符号脚手架内，对德国刑法§130(1)条款下的在线仇恨言论进行分类评估。实验对比了神经符号变体与无约束提示策略在多种LLM上的表现。
AI.result: Rulemapping在多种LLM上均表现优异：召回率维持在0.82-0.89的高水平，精确率达到0.80-0.86。相比之下，无约束提示方法的精确率仅为0.34-0.49，表明存在严重的范围漂移问题。
AI.conclusion: 专家编写的符号脚手架能够使法律自动化系统在保持高性能的同时，满足监管要求的可审计性和可验证决策标准。神经符号混合架构是实现合规法律自动化的有效路径。

title: Policy-Grounded Dynamic Facet Suggestions for Job Search
summary: Job seekers often initiate search with short, underspecified queries. At LinkedIn, over 80% of job-related queries contain three or fewer keywords, making accurate user intent inference and relevant job retrieval particularly challenging. We present dynamic facet suggestion (DFS), an interactive query refinement mechanism that facilitates intent disambiguation by surfacing personalized semantic attributes conditioned on the joint user-query context in real time. We propose a policy-grounded, retrieval-augmented ranking framework for facet suggestion, comprising offline taxonomy curation, embedding-based retrieval of top-K candidates, and distilled small language model (SLM) based candidate scoring. The system is optimized for real-time serving via pointwise single-token scoring with batching and prefix caching. Offline evaluation demonstrates high precision for generated suggestions, and online A/B tests show significant improvements in suggestion engagement and job search outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向领英求职搜索的「动态分面建议」（DFS）系统：在搜索框下方实时给出基于用户画像与查询联合上下文的个性化语义属性（如工作场所类型、行业、职能、领域知识），用户点击后把属性追加到原查询形成更明确的下一查询。方法为「策略约束 + 检索增强」两阶段框架：离线用 LLM 构建并人工校验分面词分类体系；在线用微调后的嵌入 SLM（gte-Qwen2-1.5B，InfoNCE 损失）召回 top-K 候选，再用 Qwen2.5-1.5B 生成式 SLM 做逐点（pointwise）单 token「Yes/No」打分排序，并通过 vLLM 客户端批处理与前缀缓存满足实时延迟。离线 F1 0.84、top-5 精度 91.1%，P95 延迟 150ms（相比 listwise 降 3–4 倍）；线上 A/B 显示分面 CTR +34.8%、申请/曝光比 +2.6%、成功搜索会话 +1.6%。
AI.motivation: 求职是高意图、查询短且模糊的检索问题：领英上超过 80% 的职位相关查询仅含不超过 3 个关键词，用户难以准确表达意图，导致相关职位召回困难，需要额外的引导。传统的静态下拉筛选（如职级、雇佣类型）对所有用户一视同仁，无法个性化；而现有查询扩展/改写方法（相关性反馈、PRF、LLM 生成式扩展）不适用于该场景：无约束生成易产生幻觉或违反产品策略的建议，PRF 在初始查询歧义大时会放大检索误差，而面向用户的求职搜索要求高精度与严格延迟保证。同时，生产规模部署还要求建议满足产品策略质量标准（查询相关性、用户相关性、细化效用）并能承受高并发、低成本。因此需要一种受策略约束、可控、可实时服务的交互式查询细化机制。
AI.method: 问题形式化：给定查询 q 与成员上下文 m（偏好职位、行业等），输出 K 个排序后的 (facet 类型, facet 取值) 对；仅允许「收窄型」细化，满足单调精度性质（q' 的意图必须是 q 意图的真子集），避免语义漂移。1) 策略化相关性框架：以产品策略「宪法」定义三条公理 C1 查询忠实性、C2 成员合理性、C3 细化效用，用二元标签 (Okay/Poor) 操作化；流动性约束由下游门控单独处理。采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 标注：领域专家构建金标准种子集（含对内稳定性）→ 少样本与边界案例迭代优化评审提示 → 与人类判断以 Cohen's Kappa 等一致性对齐后规模化标注，既作评测基准又作蒸馏的远程监督。2) 人在环的分面词分类体系构建：从 LinkedIn 父级职业与 ≤3 词短查询出发，用 GPT-4o 诱导候选 facet 关键词，经三维质控（策略合规判定、职位结果流动性校验、扩展查询的搜索流量热度过滤），再由专家复核；用 GPT-4o 做实体消歧与别名映射写入分类池。3) 候选召回：微调 gte-Qwen2-1.5B-instruct 为孪生编码器（查询侧 = 查询串 + 成员上下文；facet 侧 = 关键词 + 自然语言定义），采用 InfoNCE（in-batch 负采样）损失，显著优于 BCE、Pairwise Triplet、ListNet 等目标；标签来自 LLM 评判。4) 排序：Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 作为骨干，GPT-4o / Qwen3-14B 为教师，四阶段训练——Stage 0 用 LLM 评判生成带 CoT 理由的高精度语料；Stage 1 对学生与教师做含 CoT 的 SFT（F1 0.48→0.76）；Stage 2 on-policy 蒸馏，学生自采样轨迹由 14B 教师按 token 级前向 KL 评分（F1=0.85，缓解暴露偏差）；Stage 3 剥离推理链、仅保留类别标签并将提示压缩至 1/3，兼顾精度与延迟（F1=0.84，单 token 输出）。5) 服务：pointwise 单 token「Yes」概率作为排序分，客户端请求批处理 + 共享前缀（指令/成员上下文/查询）缓存于 vLLM 前缀缓存，摊销 prefill 开销。
AI.result: 离线：端到端 F1 0.84、top-5 服务分面精度 91.1%；EBR 从约 400 候选中召回 27 个（16 领域知识、5 职能、5 行业、1 工作场所类型），生产仅服务判定为「Yes」的 top-5。阶段消融如上（0.48→0.76→0.85→0.84）。延迟：listwise 451ms vs pointwise 150ms（P95 降 3–4 倍且 GPU 成本不增）；单 GPU A100 上 EBR ~40 QPS/~40ms、SLM 打分 ~15 QPS/~150ms（每请求 27 候选）；提示 token 减少约 3 倍。线上 A/B：整体分面 CTR +34.8%（p<0.0001）、Job Apply-to-Impression +2.6%（p=0.0031）、成功求职会话 +1.6%（p<0.0001）。副作用：多属性查询（职位+行业+工作场所类型）占比上升，导致下游模型出现分布外查询模式，偶发短暂相关性回退。
AI.conclusion: DFS 验证了「策略约束 + 检索增强 + 蒸馏小模型」在生产级实时建议中的可行性：LLM 辅助的分类体系构建 + 嵌入 SLM 召回 + 生成式 SLM 排序，配合单 token pointwise 打分、批处理与前缀缓存，可在高并发、严延迟约束下以低成本上线，并显著提升细化交互与下游求职效率。论文同时强调两点后续工作：(1) 交互式改写会改变查询分布，需要对下游检索/排序模型进行协同训练以维持相关性；(2) 需扩展分类体系并研究自适应候选过滤策略，在分面一致性与长尾个性化意图支持之间取得平衡。整体为在高吞吐、延迟受限的搜索环境中部署可控且策略对齐的 SLM 组件提供了可复用的实践蓝图。

title: SKG-Eval: Stateful Evaluation of Multi-Turn Dialogue via Incremental Semantic Knowledge Graphs
summary: Evaluating multi-turn dialogue systems remains challenging because response quality depends not only on the current prompt, but also on previously established entities, claims, and conversational commitments. Existing automatic evaluators, including LLM-as-a-judge frameworks and embedding-based metrics, largely rely on flat or turn-isolated representations, making them less effective at detecting long-range issues such as contradiction, topic drift, and entity inconsistency. To address this, we propose SKG-Eval, a quasi-deterministic and interpretable framework that models dialogue as an evolving Semantic Knowledge Graph (SKG) of entities, relations, and commitments across turns. The framework incrementally updates the graph through structured triple extraction and computes three complementary signals: (i) local relevance, measuring alignment with the current prompt and optional reference; (ii) historical consistency, evaluating how newly introduced information connects to prior conversational context using graph-based and embedding-driven signals; and (iii) logical coherence, assessed by a geometric contradiction engine that detects cross-turn conflicts without relying on NLI models or LLM judges. These signals are adaptively fused and aggregated into a length-invariant session score via recency-weighted trend analysis. Across multiple benchmarks, SKG-Eval achieves higher correlation with human judgments and substantially improves detection of long-range inconsistencies in extended conversations. In addition, the framework produces explicit contradiction certificates and deterministic scores for fixed inputs, enabling reproducible and auditable evaluation. Overall, our results suggest that structured externalized state tracking through semantic knowledge graphs provides a scalable alternative to implicit reasoning in LLM-based dialogue evaluators.

AI.tldr: SKG-Eval通过将对话建模为语义知识图谱，利用三元组提取追踪实体和承诺变化，计算局部相关性、历史一致性和逻辑一致性三个信号，解决了传统方法难以检测跨轮次长程一致性问题，在多基准上取得了更高的人类相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有对话评估方法依赖扁平化或孤立回合表示，无法有效检测跨轮次矛盾、话题漂移和实体不一致等长程问题
AI.method: SKG-Eval框架将对话建模为演化语义知识图谱，通过结构化三元组提取增量更新，计算局部相关性、历史一致性、逻辑一致性三个互补信号，并采用近期加权趋势分析自适应融合
AI.result: 在多基准上与人类判断相关性更高，扩展对话中长程不一致检测能力显著提升，支持可复现可审计的评估
AI.conclusion: 通过语义知识图谱进行结构化外部化状态追踪，为LLM对话评估器中的隐式推理提供了可扩展的替代方案

title: Coordinate Heterogeneity Governs Binary Quantization: From InfoNCE to Recall
comment: 17 pages, 1 figure, 15 tables (5 in main text, 10 in appendix)
summary: Binary quantization (BQ) compresses high-dimensional embeddings into one or two bits per coordinate, enabling nearest neighbor search at extreme speed. Yet a striking puzzle persists: BQ achieves competitive recall on contrastive embeddings but fails on others -- and two leading systems adopt diametrically opposite strategies (random rotation vs. preserving coordinate axes) without a common theory explaining when each is appropriate. We resolve this puzzle by connecting the Gaussian structure recently established for InfoNCE-trained representations to a complete analytical framework for BQ quality. The key insight is that coordinate heterogeneity -- the non-uniformity of per-coordinate variances -- governs the key aspects of BQ performance. We derive closed-form expressions for ranking fidelity, prove that the magnitude bit carries information proportional to heterogeneity, and show that random rotation destroys precisely the signal that one paradigm exploits while creating the isotropy that the other requires. A two-parameter scaling law predicts fidelity across models and dimensions. Experiments on 13 datasets and 6 embedding families validate all predictions and provide the first principled design guide for binary quantization systems.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个统一的解析框架，用以解释二元量化(BQ)在不同嵌入模型上的表现差异：核心变量是**坐标异质性**（各坐标方差不均匀程度）与**完整协方差结构**。结论是：(1) 排序保真度 F 由完整协方差 Σ 决定，非对角相关贡献 30–50% 信号；(2) 幅度位(magnitude bit)的额外信息量随异质性单调增长；(3) 随机旋转会抹平异质性（伤害 QuIVer 式加权 Hamming 方案），同时制造各向同性（利好 RaBitQ 式线性校正器），从而以理论统一了两种看似对立的设计哲学；(4) 由三个协方差统计量（log r_off、SNR 均值/标准差）拟合的现象学缩放律可跨模型、跨维度预测 F。
AI.motivation: 二元量化（BQ）把高维嵌入压缩到每坐标 1–2 bit，可实现极快的近邻检索，但实践中存在两个长期未解的矛盾现象：(a) BQ 在对比学习（InfoNCE）嵌入上召回率有竞争力，在其他训练范式的嵌入上却失败；(b) 两个代表性系统 RaBitQ（先做 Haar 随机旋转再二值化 + 逐向量浮点校正）与 QuIVer（保留坐标轴、在 2-bit 空间原生构建图索引）采取完全相反的坐标结构假设，却都能取得高召回。经典 LSH/SimHash 理论假设各向同性数据并只给出最坏情况保证，无法解释这种对训练目标的强依赖。缺失的关键环节是 InfoNCE 训练在表征上施加的特定统计结构（近期工作已证明其诱导近似高斯的坐标分布）。
AI.method:
方法为“概率解析 + 数值验证”的闭环范式：
1. 前提假设 H1：固定 k 个坐标的边缘联合高斯性 + 薄壳范数集中（有效秩 tr(Σ)/‖Σ‖op→∞），并给出 QQ 图 R² 与范数 CV 的经验校验。
2. 记忆分解：召回 = 排序保真度 F（量化噪声侧）与语义间隔 G（数据信号侧），通过次高斯成对误差界与 union bound 分离，本文只分析 F。
3. 定理 1（Stein 引理）：Cov(S0,T0)=Σ_ij a_i Σ_ij d_j，Stein 系数 a_i=2φ(μ_i/σ_i)/σ_i；由此得到非对角平方信号 I_off 与 D² 累积效应。
4. 定理 2（旋转）：Haar 旋转既给出随机超平面 LSH 性质，又使各坐标方差趋于一致（CV²→0）；推论 3–4 分别给出“旋转损害异质性感知 BQ”与“旋转有利于线性校正器”的方差最小化论证。
5. 命题 5：逐坐标信息比 η_i^(2) > η_i^(1)（通过 f(t)>0 的单调性证明），并将 2-bit 增益分解为 Δρ = Δ0 + K·CV²(σ) + O(CV³)，K≈0.088。
6. 附录 D 处理共享阈值的横坐标依赖，证阈值的依主收敛与 O(D^{-1/2}) 保真扰动。
7. 命题 6：基于平均场闭合 S0 与 Kruskal 公式给出缩放律 F=(6/π)arcsin((ρ0+λ r² A_m(v)²)/2)，并给出系数符号 β1>0、β2<0。
8. 实验：7 个预训练模型 + i.i.d. 高斯基线，13–18 个数据集，维度 100–3072；50K 采样、10M 随机对计算 Spearman F、暴力 Recall@10、Vamana 图索引局部放大实验；以 GIST-960、SIFT-128 作为非高斯负对照；并做方差展平/放大与打乱维度-方差的受控干预，以及 S0 失效边界的合成实验。
AI.result:
主要理论与实验结论：
- 高斯先验成立且具特异性：所有对比模型 QQ R²≥0.9959、范数 CV<0.09；GIST-960（R²≈0，CV=0.36）与 SIFT-128（AD 通过率 0%）失败。
- 完整协方差重要：仅用对角预测系统性低估 F 达 0.20–0.36，完整 Σ 预测与实测误差在 ±0.02 内（平均解释率 103%，残差 MAE 0.024）；单对相关 |ρ_ij| 仅 0.04–0.11，但在 D² 量级上累积，贡献 30–50% 信号，说明有效信息是“关系型”而非“边缘型”。
- 第二位值恒有正增益：ΔF 在 6 个数据集上为 +0.049~+0.132，ΔR 为 +0.110~+0.210；干预实验中将方差展平使 ΔF_mag 下降最多 32%，ρ(CV, ΔF_mag)=+1.0（5 个数据集中 4 个成立），确证异质性与幅度位信息量存在因果关系。
- 旋转悖论得到解释与实证：GIST（H_sign=0）旋转后召回 +307%；MiniLM/Random 已近各向同性则近似中性；Cohere 因异质性被利用而旋转略有害（−0.5pp）。旋转响应的最佳预测量是符号熵缺口 1−H_sign（ρ=0.91，p<0.001，12 数据集），而非 CV(σ)（ρ=0.66）。表 16 进一步显示 RaBitQ 校正器在 Cohere 上从 0.440 提升到 0.616，印证各向同性对线性校正的价值。
- 缩放律可预测且可诊断：拟合 F≈0.820+0.079z(log r)−0.041z(v)，R²_train=0.928、LOO-R²=0.889；跨维度外推 BGE-M3(1024) 误差 +0.012、MiniLM(384) +0.041；5 个完全未见数据集的盲验证中 OpenAI-3072 取得最高 F2bit=0.952、R@10=0.841；GIST-960 预测 F=1.037>1 越界，被用作先验失效的内置诊断；中位数阈值在高斯数据上稳定提升 F（≤+0.016）但在 GIST 上灾难性下降（−0.33）。
- 图导航局部放大：2-bit 相对 1-bit 的优势在 32-NN 局部邻域被放大 1.2–4.1 倍（均值 2.0×），可由条件集中解释。
- S0 失效边界：诊断量 ρ_rank(σ_i, 平均|相关|) 在对比数据上 <0.10（Cohere −0.08、BGE-M3 +0.08、CodeSearch +0.28、MiniLM +0.49）；合成块相关结构下误差从 ~8% 单调升至 ~20%。
- 局限：理论依赖近似坐标高斯性，对监督/手工特征、重尾“rogue dimensions”、RLHF/因果语言模型骨干可能失效；S0 假设相关结构与 SNR 排序近似独立。摘要与正文在数据集规模上口径不一（摘要称 13 数据集/6 嵌入族，arXiv 全文称 18 数据集/9 嵌入族），应以附录完整表格为准。
AI.conclusion: BQ 不应仅被视为有损压缩手段，而应被理解为一种“协方差探针”：符号位刻画坐标相对均值的方向，幅度位刻画偏离幅度，二者共同构成捕获各坐标一阶（部分二阶）矩的两比特充分统计量；这些矩携带关于点间距离的信息时（InfoNCE 诱导的高斯结构下成立），BQ 就能保住排序保真度，否则必然失败。由此，QuIVer 与 RaBitQ 并非互相竞争的方案，而是对同一协方差结构的两种对偶策略：保轴方法利用异质方差带来的隐式重要性加权（由 Hamming 距离继承），旋转方法则通过制造各向同性使线性标量校正无偏。异质性决定的是两类策略的相对有效性以及第二位值的边际收益，而非保真度的绝对水平（后者由完整协方差决定）。落地价值在于：仅凭嵌入的协方差统计量即可在不做检索实验的前提下预测 BQ 召回可行性并选择系统设计——旋转当且仅当符号熵偏低时有利，保轴在熵已高且依赖 Hamming 距离时更优；未来方向是把训练目标设计与压缩方法设计联合研究，并刻画高斯先验在各类训练范式下的稳健边界与非高斯下的鲁棒阈值策略。

title: When Actions Disappear: Adversarial Action Removal in Self-Play Reinforcement Learning
summary: We study adversarial action masking in self-play reinforcement learning: an attacker selectively removes legal actions from a victim's action set. Unlike observation or action perturbations, removal eliminates decision options before the agent acts. Across poker games scaling from 6 to 5,531 information states and two non-poker domains, learned masking causes substantially more damage than random masking and learned perturbation baselines. The attack persists across Q-learning, PPO, NFSP, neural NFSP, and DQN victims; transfers across agents; is amplified by self-play; and shows no recovery under extended masked training. Mechanistically, the adversary targets high-value decision points, captured by reach-weighted contingent action capacity (CAC$_w$) and a value-weighted refinement CAC$_v$. These results identify action availability as a distinct robustness surface in self-play RL.

AI.tldr: This paper introduces and systematically investigates adversarial action masking in self-play reinforcement learning, where an attacker removes legal actions from a victim's action set. Across diverse environments (poker games from 6 to 5,531 information states and two non-poker domains), learned masking consistently outperforms baselines, generalizes across algorithms and agents, and cannot be defended against through extended training. The core mechanism involves targeting high-value decision points using novel metrics (CAC$_w$ and CAC$_v$), revealing action availability as a critical but overlooked robustness surface in self-play RL.
AI.motivation: Existing adversarial RL research focuses primarily on observation perturbations or action perturbations (e.g., modified actions), but action removal—eliminating decision options before the agent acts—represents a fundamentally distinct attack surface that has not been systematically studied.
AI.method: The adversary uses learned action masking strategies that selectively remove legal actions from a victim's action set, with two proposed metrics: reach-weighted (CAC$_w$) and value-weighted (CAC$_v$) contingent action capacity to capture targeting of high-value decision points.
AI.result: Learned masking substantially outperforms random masking and perturbation baselines, persists across Q-learning, PPO, NFSP, neural NFSP, and DQN; transfers across agents; amplifies with self-play; and shows no recovery even under extended masked training.
AI.conclusion: This work demonstrates that adversarial action masking is a significant and distinct attack surface in self-play RL. The adversary can effectively target high-value decision points to impair victim performance across diverse algorithms and domains, with no evidence of recovery through extended training. This identifies action availability as a critical but under-explored dimension of RL robustness that warrants significant attention in the design of robust multi-agent systems.

title: Charon: A Unified and Fine-Grained Simulator for Large-Scale LLM Training and Inference
summary: Deploying large-scale LLM training and inference with optimal performance is exceptionally challenging due to a complex design space of parallelism strategies, system optimizations, and hardware configurations. Accurate and rapid performance simulation is critical for guiding optimization efforts and system studies by validating "what-if" Hooker Figure hypotheses. To address this, we introduce Charon, a unified, modular, and fine-grained simulator for accurately predicting LLM performance. Experiments show Charon achieves high accuracy across different models and configurations, with an overall prediction error consistently under 5.35%, and even under 3.74% for training with a large-scale GPU cluster. In a practical inference deployment case, Charon discovered a configuration that improved system throughput over an engineering-tuned baseline, demonstrating its significant real-world value.

AI.tldr: Charon是一个用于准确预测大语言模型(LLM)训练和推理性能的统一模块化模拟器，能够在复杂设计空间中快速评估不同并行策略和配置方案，预测误差低于5.35%，已证明在实际部署中能发现优于人工调优的性能配置。
AI.motivation: 大规模LLM训练和推理系统的部署面临复杂性挑战，涉及并行策略、系统优化和硬件配置的复杂设计空间。准确且快速地进行性能模拟对于指导优化工作和系统研究至关重要，需要验证"假设分析"场景。
AI.method: Charon采用统一、模块化、细粒度的设计架构，实现对LLM性能的准确预测。该模拟器通过模块化设计支持不同的并行策略、系统优化和硬件配置的灵活组合与评估。
AI.result: 实验表明Charon在不同模型和配置下均达到高预测精度，总体预测误差始终低于5.35%，在大规模GPU集群训练场景下甚至低于3.74%。在实际推理部署案例中，Charon发现了一种优于工程调优基线的配置方案，显著提升了系统吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: Charon是一个统一、模块化、细粒度的LLM性能模拟器，能够准确预测大规模语言模型的训练和推理性能，在实际部署中发现了优于人工调优基线的配置方案，证明了其在实际应用中的显著价值。

title: What's Inside a GitHub Repository? An Empirical Study on the Contents of 10K Projects
summary: GitHub is the largest code hosting platform, with millions of repositories spanning multiple technologies. Despite this, little is known about the actual contents of GitHub's repositories in the wild. This paper presents an initial empirical analysis to better understand the contents of real-world GitHub repositories. We analyze the files, directories, and extensions present in 10,000 GitHub repositories, as well as their evolution over ten years. Our results show major changes in GitHub over the last decade: (1) the consolidation of README.md, .gitignore, and LICENSE as standard artifacts; (2) the rise of GitHub Actions as the dominant CI/CD platform; (3) the growth of configuration formats such as TOML, YAML, and JSON, alongside a decline in XML; (4) new trends, such as the growth of Dockerfile; and (5) emerging content related to LLMs and generative AI (e.g., AGENTS.md). Based on our findings, we discuss implications, including that open source is not only evolving organically but also increasingly guided by GitHub's standards, the rise and fall of technologies, and the potential support for mining software repository studies.

AI.tldr: 本文对 10,000 个真实 GitHub 仓库做了一次横跨"文件/目录/扩展名"三个维度的全量普查，并对比 2016、2021、2026 三个快照刻画十年演变。主要发现：README.md、.gitignore、LICENSE 已固化为标准产物；GitHub Actions 成为主导 CI/CD（.github 与 workflows 目录占比均从约 5%/0.2% 升至 82%+）；TOML/YAML/JSON 配置格式上升、XML 衰退；C/C++、Java、PHP 份额下滑而 Python、JavaScript 上升；Dockerfile、package.json 快速增长；最突出的新兴内容是 LLM/生成式 AI 与编码代理产物（CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、copilot-instructions.md、skills/、.claude/、mcp/ 等）。论文进一步讨论了 GitHub 平台标准对开源生态的引导作用、技术兴衰量化以及为 MSR 研究提供"文件级知识库/制品分类法"的基础。
AI.motivation: GitHub 承载了全球最大的开源代码库，也是软件工程（SE）与 Mining Software Repositories（MSR）研究的主要数据源（支撑超过 70% 的 MSR 研究）。然而学界与业界对真实仓库"实际包含什么"缺乏系统性实证认识：许多软件开发最佳实践（如 CONTRIBUTING.md 贡献指南、CI/CD 配置、许可证文件、编码代理说明文件）常被推荐却极少被量化验证其真实采用率。同时，新兴的 LLM/生成式 AI 制品（如 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md）正在快速进入仓库，但目前也缺乏对其规模与普及度的刻画。作者认为不应靠假设来决定研究对象与教学/工程实践，而应基于实证证据来了解开发者在仓库中实际放置了哪些文件、目录与扩展名，从而服务于三类受众：实践者（对标常见实践）、研究者（构建更具代表性的数据集）、教育者（使教学贴近真实开发）。此外，作者还希望通过持续更新的全量数据集来支撑后续的"仓库制品分类法"构建。
AI.method: 研究设计：作者使用 SEART GitHub Search Engine（seart-ghs）筛选仓库，条件为：至少 100 次提交、非 fork、2026 年内至少有一次提交、至少 100 个 star（star 在 MSR 文献中常作为流行度代理指标）。初始得到 116,013 个仓库，从中随机抽样 10,000 个（随机采样以避免只覆盖最热门项目），中位数 star 211、提交 557，覆盖 44 种主要编程语言，包含 Microsoft、Google、Facebook 等机构项目。数据采集：通过 GitHub REST API 的 Git trees 接口抓取每个仓库的全部文件、目录与扩展名；时间维度取 2016、2021、2026 三个快照，其中 2026 年为 10,000 仓库（含 10,904,237 文件、1,970,740 目录、14,770 种扩展名），2021 年取其中仍存在的 6,371 个仓库，2016 年取 2,591 个仓库。分析围绕两个研究问题展开：RQ1 当前仓库中常见哪些文件/目录/扩展名（含对 Markdown 文件、dotfiles、无扩展名文件的细分，以及对"新兴"文件/目录/扩展名的识别）；RQ2 这些内容在十年间如何演变（按文件、目录、扩展名分别统计占比增减与中位数规模变化）。数据集已公开以支持后续研究。
AI.result: RQ1（当前状态）：最常见文件为 README.md（95.3%）、.gitignore（95.0%）、LICENSE（73.1%），其后为 package.json（33.3%）、CONTRIBUTING.md（31.7%）、CHANGELOG.md（27.9%）；最常见目录为 .github（82.5%）、workflows（77.3%）、src（60.1%）、docs（37.4%）、tests（35.5%）；最常见扩展名为 md（98.6%）、gitignore（95.0%）、yml（84.1%）、json（69.2%）。Markdown 细分显示 README、CONTRIBUTING、CHANGELOG、CODE_OF_CONDUCT（16.2%）、SECURITY（13.5%）等开源最佳实践文件占主导；dotfiles 多为 Git 相关（.gitignore、.gitattributes 24.4%、.editorconfig 20.1%、.dockerignore 12.8%、.gitmodules 9.9%）；无扩展名文件集中在构建自动化（Dockerfile 23.9%、Makefile 23.4%、gradlew 7.0%）与文档治理（LICENSE、CODEOWNERS 10.2%、AUTHORS）两类。新兴内容绝大多数与 LLM/生成式 AI/编码代理相关：CLAUDE.md（9.0%）、AGENTS.md（8.5%）、SKILL.md（5.5%）、copilot-instructions.md（3.1%），目录 skills（5.7%）、.claude（4.5%）、mcp（2.4%）、.cursor（1.6%）、.agents（1.2%）、openai（0.8%）；新兴扩展名以 .mts（2.2%）领先。RQ2（十年演变）：仓库整体"变大变杂"，每仓库文件中位数从 111（2016）→131（2021）→211（2026），目录 20→27→42，扩展名 12→14→17。关键变化：README.md 77.8%→95.3%（+17.5）、LICENSE 50.8%→73.1%（+22.3）、package.json 17.2%→33.3%（+16.1）、Dockerfile 5.7%→23.9%（+18.2）；.travis.yml 从 46.4% 骤降至 5.3%（-41.1），appveyor.yml 亦下滑；目录 .github 5.3%→82.5%（+77.2）、workflows 0.2%→77.3%（+77.1）、ISSUE_TEMPLATE 0.1%→28.2%（+28.1）；扩展名 .yaml +35.9、.toml +33.0、.yml +30.9、.json +30.3，而 .xml -6.4、.c -8.3、.h -7.2、.in -7.0、.java -6.2、.php -4.4，.py +10.0、.js +7.5。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心结论是：GitHub 仓库内容在过去十年发生了结构性变化——README.md/.gitignore/LICENSE 已固化为标准制品，GitHub Actions 取代 Travis CI 成为主导 CI/CD 平台，轻量配置格式（TOML/YAML/JSON）取代 XML，Python/JavaScript 份额上升而 C/C++/Java/PHP 下降，Dockerfile 与 package.json 成为新趋势，同时出现与 LLM 和编码代理强相关的新兴内容（AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 等）。作者提出三点影响：(1) 开源生态的演进不再仅是自发的，也越来越被平台标准引导——README/LICENSE/.gitignore 正是 GitHub 建仓模板所推荐甚至可自动生成的产物，GitHub 可考虑进一步为新仓库提供 CI/CD 与 issue 管理模板支持；(2) 研究可量化技术的"兴起与衰落"（Travis CI→GitHub Actions、setup.py→pyproject.toml），维护者持续适应新技术，研究者可进一步探究迁移原因并提出自动化过渡方案，教育者与实践者亦可据此指导技术选型；(3) 本研究是面向大规模、可持续更新的 GitHub 内容理解的起点，将为 MSR 研究提供"先识别目标文件再抽样"的机制，例如用 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 定位编码代理研究对象、用 CONTRIBUTING.md 定位贡献指南研究、用 LICENSE/CHANGELOG/package.json/pom.xml/setup.py/pyproject.toml/Dockerfile 分别做许可、破坏性变更、依赖、打包与容器化分析，并计划扩展到超大规模、细化跨领域分析、构建仓库制品分类法与可视化追踪平台。有效性威胁在于样本限定于 2026 年活跃维护、≥100 star 的开源 GitHub 仓库，结果未必推广到低活跃/低流行度项目、闭源项目或其他托管平台（GitLab、Bitbucket）。

title: Fast and Practical Single-Exponential Algorithms for Branchwidth
summary:
In this paper, we present exact exponential algorithms for computing branchwidth that are fast both in theory and in practice. The running times of these algorithms are single-exponential in the number of vertices. Our basic algorithm is based on a conceptually simple recurrence on vertex sets and computes the branchwidth of an $n$-vertex hypergraph in time $\mathcal{O}^*(4^n)$. This is the first single-exponential time algorithm for hypergraphs.
  We have two algorithms tailored specifically for graphs. The first algorithm runs in time $\mathcal{O}(3.293^n)$, improving upon the previously best-known running time of $\mathcal{O}(3.4652^n)$ [Fomin-Mazoit-Todinca, DAM 2009]. Moreover, our computational experiment shows that it overwhelmingly outperforms state-of-the-art practical algorithms for computing branchwidth. The second algorithm is a candidate for a theoretical improvement: we conjecture that it runs in time $\mathcal{O}(c^n)$ for some constant $c$ that is smaller than 3.293. In practice, it performs significantly better on some instances that are hard for the first algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出计算分支宽度的精确指数算法。超图基础算法O*(4^n)为首个单指数时间算法；两图专用算法分别达O(3.293^n)（已优于前人O(3.4652^n)）和推测更优的O(c^n)（c<3.293）。实验表明算法实际性能远超现有实用方案。
AI.motivation: 现有分支宽度算法要么非单指数复杂度，要么虽为单指数但性能不理想，需要理论突破与实用性能的双重改进
AI.method: 基于顶点集上概念简单的递归关系设计精确指数算法
AI.result: 超图基本算法实现O*(4^n)；图算法1达O(3.293^n)；图算法2推测可降至O(c^n)且c<3.293，实际对困难实例表现更优
AI.conclusion: 该研究在超图和图的分支宽度精确指数算法方面取得突破。基础算法O*(4^n)是首个针对超图的单指数时间算法；图算法O(3.293^n)优于前人O(3.4652^n)，且实际表现显著超过现有实用算法。

title: Bimodal Synchronization Performance: Why Noise and Sparse Connectivity Can Improve Collective Timing
summary: Pulse-coupled oscillator models inspired by firefly synchronization are widely used to study decentralized time coordination in distributed systems. We analyze a discrete-time, discrete-phase firefly-inspired synchronization model and show that collective synchrony emerges only near a critical balance between the quorum threshold (fraction of pulsing neighbors required to trigger a phase update) and the pulse duration (how long agents remain detectable to others). Within this parameter region, the system exhibits bimodal performance: it either reaches near-perfect synchronization or becomes trapped in stable multi-cluster states, where symmetrically phase-offset subgroups mutually reinforce one another and prevent global synchrony. Our analysis shows that reducing connectivity or introducing noise suppresses these low-performance states by breaking such symmetric interactions, indicating that highly connected or noiseless systems are not necessarily optimal for collective synchronization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究离散时间、离散相位的萤火虫式脉冲耦合振子同步模型，发现全局同步只在法定阈值θ与闪光时长f近似相等（θ≈f）的狭窄参数区域内出现，且该区域呈双峰性能：同参数不同随机运行要么近乎完美同步，要么陷入稳定的相位错开多簇锁定态。机制是"对称性诱导的子群锁定"：各相位偏移的子群通过法定人数规则互相强化相位差而无法合并。降低连通度（删边）或引入更新噪声可打破这种对称性，抑制低性能态，从而提升同步率——即"越少即是越多"。
AI.motivation: 经典脉冲耦合振子理论通常认为提高连通性有利于同步（节点获得更多时序信息），但该假设在分布式系统实践中并不总成立。Kuckling等在多机器人系统中发现密度升高会导致双峰性能（拥堵崩溃），但既有解释局限于空间拥堵/物理阻塞，缺少动力学层面的机制解释。作者希望回答：在去中心化、无全局时钟的系统中，全连接无噪声是否必然导致同步？如果不是，失败态的机制是什么，能否通过设计噪声或稀疏交互加以缓解？这对轻量级资源受限的系统（如水下群体机器人、超轻飞行无人机）具有实践意义。
AI.method: 构建离散时间离散相位模型：N个智能体各持周期为C的内部时钟c_i(t)∈{0,…,C−1}，每步自增1并在周期末f比例的相位段处于闪光状态F_i(t)；在闪光起始相位(1−f)C+1处，若闪光邻居比例超过法定阈值θ，则时钟额外前进一格（相位加速）。网络为随机几何图（通信半径r）或k-正则双向随机图。性能指标为最大振幅A_max（某时刻同时闪光个体比例），A_max≥0.85判定为同步，每组参数进行1000次独立重复（主分析T=10³、C=10、N=100；参数扫描T=10⁴、N∈[50,190]、C∈[10,70]）。两类扰动：(1) 更新噪声——以概率σ翻转法定决策（Bernoulli翻转），得U_i与时钟更新c_i(t+1)=c_i(t)+1+U_i；(2) 连通度扰动——随机删边使k=N−1−⌊σN⌋，每次运行重新生成连通图。实现于Python（igraph），代码与补充材料公开于GitHub。通过θ–f二维扫描定位同步窗口，再在θ=f=0.5平衡区用噪声与删边参数扫描N–C空间绘制相图，并做k奇偶性对比。
AI.result: 1) 同步只在θ≈f的窄区域内出现：θ≫f时闪光过短过稀无法触发足够相位推进；f≫θ时规则过于宽松，多个相位簇同时满足触发条件而保持相位差，形成稳定多簇态。2) 该区域呈双峰分布：同一参数下独立运行要么近乎完美同步（A_max接近1），要么陷入A_max<0.85的稳定多簇锁定态。3) 机制被归因为对称性诱导的子群锁定：相位均匀初始化时系统自发分成若干等距相位偏移子群，簇间互相提供超过θN的闪光邻居使各簇同时推进，从而永久维持相位差、全局同步被阻断。4) 噪声扰动：σ从0增至约0.1–0.4可显著扩大良同步区域（C越大低同步越多，因可用相位槽位更多、持久子群更易形成）；σ>0.5后法定规则被频繁反转，驱动主动去同步，全面崩溃。5) 删边扰动：随σ增大良同步区域扩大至σ=0.8，但效果弱于更新噪声；σ=0.9时链接过少、同步基本消失。6) 稀疏正则图存在k奇偶效应：θ=0.5下小奇数k（5,7,…,19）同步困难，偶数k（6,8,…,20）同步最强（作者称此解释目前仅为经验性，留待后续机制分析）。7) 与Kuckling等的多机器人双峰现象相比，本文机制为相位空间对称性锁定而非物理拥堵，且模型中未观察到迟滞现象（同步达成后改变连通度不会破坏同步）。
AI.conclusion: 全局同步仅出现在法定阈值与闪光时长临界平衡的窄窗口内，且该窗口内性能是双峰的；失败源于对称性诱导的子群锁定而非个体噪声或连接不足。因此"完全信息"可能有害：过度规则化的交互结构会稳定难以逃逸的低性能集体态。降低连通度或引入决策噪声都能打破对称性并恢复全局同步，说明通信/决策的不完美在特定条件下反而有益（"less is more"）。论文进一步推测双峰性能可能是可扩展分布式系统的普遍特征：既可源于空间拥堵，也可源于相位空间中的对称锁定。未来工作需检验该现象是特定于该脉冲耦合模型的同步机制，还是可推广到更广泛的同步模型与协调问题，并需对k奇偶效应给出机制性解释。

title: From Reactive to Proactive: A Multi-Regulatory Empirical Analysis of 480 AI Incidents and a Data-Driven Governance Compliance Framework
summary: Artificial intelligence systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, yet it remains unclear whether existing governance frameworks ensure accountability after deployment. This study makes two contributions. First, it presents a cross-regulatory empirical analysis of 480 real-world AI incidents from the AI Incident Database (AIID), evaluating their alignment with post-deployment provisions in three major governance frameworks: the EU AI Act (Articles 72-73), the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (MANAGE and GOVERN functions), and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR Articles 22, 33-35). The results reveal substantial governance gaps across these frameworks, indicating persistent weaknesses in post-deployment accountability. Second, based on these findings, the study proposes the Proactive AI Governance Compliance Framework (PAGCF), a four-phase lifecycle methodology designed to shift governance from reactive incident response toward pre-deployment compliance assurance. The framework includes risk-stratified governance tiers, an implementation checklist linked to specific regulatory provisions, and a projected impact analysis that uses internal monitoring as a proxy for proactive governance capacity.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析480起真实AI事故，评估了欧盟AI法案、NIST AI风险管理框架和GDPR三个主要治理框架的部署后问责能力，发现这些框架存在显著治理缺口，并据此提出主动式AI治理合规框架(PAGCF)，旨在将AI治理从被动响应转向主动合规保证。
AI.motivation: 人工智能系统在高风险领域部署日益增多，但现有治理框架在部署后的问责制方面存在不足，亟需评估现行监管框架对已部署AI系统的治理能力。
AI.method: 交叉监管实证分析：收集480起来自AI事件数据库(AIID)的真实AI事故案例，将其与三个主要治理框架的部署后条款进行对齐度评估：欧盟AI法案(第72-73条)、NIST AI风险管理框架(MANAGE和GOVERN功能)、通用数据保护条例(GDPR第22、33-35条)。
AI.result: 实证分析揭示了三个主要治理框架之间存在显著治理缺口，表明部署后问责机制存在持续性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 基于480起AI事故的实证分析结果，提出主动式AI治理合规框架(PAGCF)，该框架采用四阶段生命周期方法，将治理重心从被动事件响应转向主动部署前合规保证，包含风险分层治理层级的实施清单及预测性影响分析。

title: RAPT: Retrieval-Augmented Post-hoc Thresholding for Multi-Label Classification
summary: Industrial multi-label document understanding pipelines score candidate labels and threshold or rank them to form a label set per document. This early selection step directly affects the accuracy of downstream information extraction from the document, as well as the associated verification effort. In practice, OCR noise, label imbalance, instance-dependent label cardinality, and asymmetric error costs make global score thresholds brittle and hard to maintain as document formats evolve. We present RAPT, a deployment-oriented retrieval-augmented score thresholding wrapper, applied post-hoc to improve label set selection without retraining the underlying classifier. RAPT is a model-agnostic wrapper: any predictor that provides document representations for similarity search and per label confidence scores can be used, including metric learning encoders and fine-tuned transformer classifiers. For each query document, given a classifier's score vector, RAPT retrieves similar document thresholding situations (cases) and adapts the query's label set selection threshold using their outcomes. The adaptation selects the final label set by locally aggregating neighbour solutions (e.g. average label count, cutoff calibration). Evaluation compared multi-label classifiers (metric learners and transformers) combined with RAPT against global and label-wise thresholding baselines, and against few-shot LLMs. Across an industrial dataset and six public benchmarks, RAPT consistently outperformed global and label-wise static thresholding baselines. In the industrial setting, RAPT achieved its best predictive performance with metric learners, reaching 0.87 Macro-F1, while fine-tuned transformer variants on average achieved 0.775 Macro-F1, outperforming fewshot LLM baselines (K = 5) by 2x and requiring at least 115x less inference time and 13.5x less GPU memory.

AI.tldr: RAPT is a retrieval-augmented post-hoc wrapper that improves multi-label document classification thresholds by retrieving similar cases and locally adapting thresholds, achieving strong performance without retraining the underlying classifier.
AI.motivation: Industrial multi-label document pipelines suffer from brittle global score thresholds due to OCR noise, label imbalance, instance-dependent label cardinality, asymmetric error costs, and evolving document formats.
AI.method: RAPT is a model-agnostic retrieval-augmented wrapper applied post-hoc to improve label set selection. It retrieves similar document thresholding cases for each query, then locally aggregates neighbor solutions (e.g., average label count, cutoff calibration) to adapt thresholds per document.
AI.result: RAPT achieves 0.87 Macro-F1 (best) with metric learners on industrial data and 0.775 average with transformers on public benchmarks, outperforming static baselines and few-shot LLMs by 2x with 115x less inference time and 13.5x less GPU memory.
AI.conclusion: RAPT consistently outperforms static thresholding baselines across industrial and public datasets; metric learner variant achieves 0.87 Macro-F1 in industrial setting while fine-tuned transformers average 0.775, outperforming few-shot LLMs by 2x with 115x faster inference and 13.5x lower GPU memory requirements.

title: A Scalable Tool for Measuring Manner and Result Verbs in Developmental Language Research
summary: Manner and result verbs encode different aspects of event structure and have been discussed in developmental work as a potentially informative distinction for studying early verb learning. However, this distinction remains difficult to measure at scale because large annotated resources for manner and result classification are not currently available. We present a computational approach for identifying manner and result verbs in sentence context. Using linguistically informed prompts, we generate sentence-level annotations with large language models over data drawn from MASC and InterCorp, extending coverage from previously annotated portions of VerbNet to 436 classes. We then train a RoBERTa-based classifier on these annotations and evaluate it on three held-out gold-standard datasets, including previously annotated items and a new expert-annotated set. Across these evaluations, the model shows promising performance, with average accuracy up to 89.6%. We present this work as a scalable measurement tool that can support future research on verb semantics in developmental and other language datasets, while noting that further validation is needed for borderline cases, mixed manner/result verbs, and downstream developmental applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型和RoBERTa分类器的计算方法，用于自动识别句子语境中的方式动词（Manner Verbs）和结果动词（Result Verbs），将VerbNet的标注覆盖从原有部分扩展至436个类别，并在多个保留测试集上达到89.6%的平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 方式动词与结果动词的区分对早期动词习得研究具有重要意义，但现有大规模标注资源匮乏，难以支撑大规模测量和研究需求。
AI.method: 1）利用语言学知识的提示工程（linguistically informed prompts）引导大语言模型生成句子级标注；2）数据来源为MASC和InterCorp语料库；3）基于RoBERTa微调训练分类器；4）在三个保留测试集（含新专家标注集）上进行评估。
AI.result: 模型在多个保留测试集上表现良好，最高平均准确率达89.6%，成功将标注覆盖扩展至VerbNet的436个类别。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可作为方式/结果动词分类的可扩展测量工具，支持未来动词语义的发展心理学研究。但边界案例、混合动词及下游发展应用场景仍需进一步验证。

title: Agentic Cost-Aware Query Planning with Knowledge Distillation for Big Data Analytics
summary: Query optimization in big data analytics remains computationally expensive, particularly for resource-constrained environments where traditional optimizers fail to satisfy memory and latency constraints. We present an agentic query planning system that combines a rule-based teacher planner, UCB1 bandit exploration, cost-aware prediction, and knowledge distillation to a lightweight student planner. Our teacher planner generates SQL plans using six key optimization strategies, while UCB1 bandit search efficiently explores the plan space under explicit resource constraints. A Random Forest cost model predicts query latency from plan features, enabling cost-aware decisions. A distilled student planner (Logistic Regression or Gradient Boosting) learns to mimic teacher-bandit decisions for fast inference. Evaluation on NYC Taxi and IMDB datasets demonstrates 23% latency reduction compared to default planners while maintaining 94% constraint satisfaction. The student planner achieves 89% accuracy in replicating optimal plans with 15x faster inference time. Our single-file implementation enables reproducible big-data analytics on resource-limited machines and is publicly available at https://github.com/mahdinaser/agentic-kd-planner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于强化学习与知识蒸馏的智能查询规划系统，通过UCB1 bandit探索、随机森林成本模型和知识蒸馏技术，将复杂教师规划器的决策能力迁移至轻量级学生规划器，在保证资源约束满足率94%的前提下，实现23%的延迟降低和15倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 大数据分析中的查询优化在资源受限环境下计算开销大，传统优化器无法满足内存和延迟约束需求。
AI.method: 系统包含四个核心组件：(1) 基于规则的教师规划器，使用六种优化策略生成SQL执行计划；(2) UCB1 bandit算法在显式资源约束下高效探索计划空间；(3) 随机森林成本模型从计划特征预测查询延迟；(4) 知识蒸馏将教师- bandit决策迁移至轻量级学生规划器（逻辑回归或梯度提升）。
AI.result: 在NYC Taxi和IMDB数据集上评估，系统相比默认规划器降低23%延迟，保持94%约束满足率；学生规划器以15倍推理速度达到89%的最优计划复制准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该单文件实现方案可在资源受限机器上实现可复现的大数据分析，代码已开源。

title: A Structural Threshold in Decision Capacity Governs Collapse in Self-Play Reinforcement Learning
summary: We show that a threshold in decision capacity determines whether self-play reinforcement learning agents collapse under asymmetric rule perturbations. Across poker variants, matrix games, a dice game, and multiple learning algorithms, eliminating all positive-reach contingent decisions causes rapid convergence to a deterministic exploitation attractor, a fixed point at near-maximal loss. Preserving even a single positive-reach contingent decision point prevents this collapse. A frozen baseline and fixed-opponent control confirm that the mechanism is co-adaptation under constraint, not the perturbation itself. The phenomenon is timing-invariant, fully reversible upon action restoration, and intensifies under function approximation. These results establish a sharp threshold at zero reach-weighted contingent action capacity, with severity scaling continuously via reach-weighted capacity in the tested domains.

AI.tldr: 研究发现强化学习智能体在非对称规则扰动下存在一个由可达加权偶然行动能力决定的崩溃阈值：完全消除偶然决策能力导致近乎最大损失的确定性吸引子，而保留任意一个偶然决策点即可避免崩溃，且该现象在函数近似下更为严重。
AI.motivation: 探索自对弈强化学习智能体在非对称规则扰动下为何会崩溃，并寻找其决定性阈值条件。
AI.method: 跨多个领域（扑克变体、矩阵博弈、骰子游戏）和多种学习算法进行系统性实验，通过冻结基线和固定对手控制排除干扰变量，并测试时间不变性、可逆性和函数近似条件下的表现。
AI.result: 当消除所有正可达的偶然决策时，智能体会快速收敛到确定性剥削吸引子（接近最大损失的固定点）；仅保留一个偶然决策点即可防止此崩溃。该现象时间不变、完全可逆，且在函数近似下加剧。
AI.conclusion: 存在一个在零可达加权偶然行动能力处的急剧阈值，且严重程度在所测域中随可达加权能力连续缩放。

title: Send: Objects, History, and Transactions in a Single-Verb Kernel
comment: 17 pages. Companion preprint of Onward! Papers 2026 submission
summary:
Multi-party object coordination - across object-capability systems, smart-contract platforms, distributed actors, and event-sourced architectures - is shaped by six structural properties: authenticated provenance, opaque encapsulation, atomic multi-object commit, deterministic replay, immutable history, and history-derived state. Existing systems compose subsets via separate layered mechanisms (RPC, capability ACLs, transaction coordinators, event journals, vat boundaries); each layer is well-studied but the combination is fragile. We present a minimal kernel which makes them jointly compatible.
  Our kernel is built from s-expressions, a uniform 'send' interface, transactions, and one primitive object distinction: *ephemeral* (caller's context inherited) vs. *persistent* (context switches to the target's kernel-assigned identity and append-only log). The kernel structurally classifies every send target into one of six cases without input from the caller - uniform caller interface, intensional kernel dispatch.
  Under kernel-faithful trust (the kernel runs its semantics as specified), this design holds all six properties as *kernel-level* against arbitrary programs - the kernel's transition function refuses states violating them. Opacity *against the operator* additionally requires operator-faithful trust (the operator accesses logs only via 'recall' and does not censor or reorder transactions); under kernel-faithful alone, five of six guarantees survive an unconstrained operator. Append-only logs underpin immutability, replay, and history-derived state; kernel-controlled persistent dispatch yields authenticated provenance and opacity; transactions deliver atomic coordination. Operator-adversarial deployments can be realized with a cryptographic compiler.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个极小的"单一动词内核"（kernel），用 s-表达式、统一的 send 接口、事务机制，以及唯一的一组原始区分——持久对象（persistent，具名、有日志、切换上下文）与临时对象（ephemeral、匿名、无日志、继承上下文）——把对象能力系统、智能合约平台、分布式 actor 与事件溯源架构中常见的六项结构属性（认证溯源、不透明封装、原子多对象提交、确定性重放、不可变历史、历史派生状态）从"多层机制拼装"改造为"内核级（kernel-level）强制保证"。内核由结构性地把每个 send 目标划分为六类（内建、内核、持久、特殊 pair、外部、临时）来决定行为，调用者接口统一、分派由内核内省式完成。论文同时给出形式化操作语义（send / run / execute）、关键定理（确定性重放、读取约束、非泄漏）与一个具体实例化（ℕ 上的原子编号、六个纯内建、五条指令、pair-chain 日志编码），并通过委托链问责与密封拍卖两个案例研究说明该设计可承载常见对象系统模式。
AI.motivation: 多主体对象协调领域——跨越对象能力系统（Self、Spritely Goblins、KeyKOS）、智能合约平台（EVM）、分布式 actor 框架（Akka、Erlang/OTP）与事件溯源架构（Datomic、Urbit）——共同面临六项结构属性：认证溯源（authenticated provenance）、不透明封装（opaque encapsulation）、原子多对象提交（atomic multi-object commit）、确定性重放（deterministic replay）、不可变历史（immutable history）、历史派生状态（history-derived state）。现状是每项属性各由独立的分层机制提供（RPC、能力 ACL、事务协调器、事件日志、vat 边界），每层单独都研究充分，但组合起来很脆弱：接口倍增、跨层不变量易被违反、安全性质沿层边界泄漏；状态仍存放在可变快照中，必须与事件日志保持同步才能可审计。论文提出的核心问题是：能否不靠分层叠加、而是直接以内核级（kernel-level）保证同时满足这六项？论文进一步区分"内核级强制"与"用户级约定"这一此前未被明确使用的判据：Smalltalk 的 instVarAt:、Akka Persistence 的非确定性事件处理器都把性质降级为用户级；本文主张存在一种内核使六者统一为内核级。此外作者刻意限定信任范围：内核忠实（kernel-faithful）即可对任意程序成立六项；而"对操作者的不透明"额外需要操作者忠实（operator-faithful，含提交忠实、排序忠实、读忠实三个子条件）；在操作者对抗情形下内核不解决该问题，而由密码学编译器（Viaduct 式）作为标准补救。
AI.method:
论文以"目标表示（target representation）"而非表层语言为定位：它是一个结构规范，源语言编译到它，密码学编译器把它当作"必须在敌对操作者下保持不透明、原子、可重放验证"的规格。

形式化（第3节）：数据域为 s-表达式 𝒮 = A + 𝒮×𝒮；全局持久状态 K ∈ (A×A×𝒮)*，条目 (n,c,m) 表示持久对象 n 收到来自调用者 c 的消息 m；派生操作 log(n,K)、exists、Pers(K)、program(n,K)（取自首条"出生记录"）。参数包括 encode（可注入日志编码）、Π（实例定义的 pair 形式分派）、Ext/Eph（外部与临时目标集合）、B（内建）、alloc（身份分配），并给出五条可容许性约束：Π 匹配对/Ext/Eph 划分 𝒮×𝒮；builtin 仅定义在 B 上；alloc 返回 B ∪ {a_kernel, a_ext} ∪ Pers 之外的新原子；encode 单射；程序模型纯净（不可观察 K、时间、随机性）。三个核心定义：send（按优先级七分支的首匹配分派：内建→内核→持久→特殊 pair→外部→临时→否则 abort）、run（栈式小步解释器，指令集为 push/quote/send/recall/abort，回忆位置 0=程序、1=消息、2=self、3=日志、4=调用者）、execute（一次提交 = 一个原子事务，全提交或全回滚；外部发送在 abort 时丢弃）。系统层为顺序处理 (K,T)，T 记录每笔交易与其结果及外部发送，是唯一的非确定性来源。

关键设计论证（第2节）：ephemeral/persistent 轴捆绑了身份（具名/匿名）、日志（有/无）、上下文（切换/继承）三组子区分；在六项性质均为内核级的定义下，8 种配置中只有"具名+有日志+切换"（persistent）与"匿名+无日志+继承"（ephemeral）两个端点同时满足全部六项，其余六种各至少违反一项，并给出逐项违反表（如 named+unlogged+switching 违反重放/不可变/历史派生状态，即传统 Smalltalk/Self 的可变对象语义）。

第4节推导结构性质：不可变历史与确定性重放源自仅追加日志；认证溯源源自内核在位置 4 设定调用者（程序无法伪造或抑制）；不透明源自不存在任何跨对象读原语；原子协调源自事务语义；历史派生状态源自位置 3 的日志访问。Theorem 1（确定性重放：给定交易序列，终态唯一确定）、Theorem 2（读取约束：任何持久日志的读写都必须经由显式 send 的分派路径）、Proposition 4（中止队列信号：同笔交易的共同参与者在提交或中止结局上观察到共同信号，这是原子性的内在结果而非泄漏）、Theorem 3（模 abort-cohort 的内核级非泄漏：对任意 O，若两次执行的输入观测不变，则 O 以外的状态、外部发送与响应值一致）。作者明确指出 Theorem 3 是条件式结果：程序级可观测性不变性 (i)(ii) 需由工程保证，内核的贡献是无条件成立的 Theorem 2；因此"程序级非干扰"归约为"编写合格程序"。

第5节给出一个实例化：A = ℕ，保留原子 [0,14) 分四层（身份 0=KERNEL、1=EXTERNAL；指令编码 2=send、3=recall、4=FAIL、5=quote；分派标签 6=PAIR_TAG、7=EXTERNAL_TAG；六个纯内建 8=HEAD、9=TAIL、10=PAIR、11=EQUAL、12=BRANCH、13=INCREMENT）。alloc(K+Δ) = 14 + |log(0,K+Δ)|（确定性顺序分配，作者坦承这使"身份模式不透明"仅为用户级，因为可对已知身份做 INCREMENT 探测邻接分配；改用 alloc(K)=h(nonce(K)) 的单向哈希分配即可恢复内核级）。指令集为五操作 push/quote/send/recall/abort，程序即链表，解释器给出完整小步语义；日志用 pair-chain 编码并以 0 收尾。作者强调该指令集是"sufficiency 演示"而非可用语法，BRANCH 分支点约需 18 条指令。

第6节讨论组合：局部性（部分知识执行 K_local ⊂ K_global；跨实例交互退化为外部发送，跨域溯源与原子性需额外协议）；复制与分片（T 即共识/复制协议的命令日志；分片间交互为外部发送，跨分片原子性需两阶段提交等叠加层）；冲突可串行化调度与并行度下限（因为任何跨持久对象访问都写接收者日志，冲突图为稠密的"仅写-写"冲突，共享协调对象成为瓶颈，牺牲了 OCC 的读-写并行性）；日志规范性与保留（K 规范且不可截断，|K| 单调增长；通过编译期插入检查点自发送把每条消息 O(|history|) 的代价摊为 O(1)；崩溃恢复用 (T, Δ_i) 原子持久化 + 组提交，无撤销无重执行，外部发送至少一次投递需端点按 tx 去重）。

第7节给出模式目录：Self 式委托、Smalltalk 式类与 super-sends、元对象协议、克隆/代码变更（bootloader 模式）、基于身份的门控访问控制（因身份即能力且不可衰减撤销）、异步消息、阶段门控状态机与两方托管；并明确不可编码者（Smalltalk 的 instVarAt:put:、Self 的 become:、捕获他人执行栈的 first-class continuations，因违反 Theorem 2）。两个案例研究：案例一（委托链问责）用三个实验对照，唯一差异是目标被分类为 ephemeral（上下文继承，B 见 caller=14/16）还是 persistent（上下文切换，B 见 caller=17）；案例二（密封拍卖）以拍卖师 A 创建 canonical 程序的出价对象 B_i、绑定竞价人 β_i，REVEAL_ALL 在单笔事务内原子揭示所有出价，故任一 B_i 中止则整体中止、结构性杜绝"观察他人后选择性撤标"，六项性质各自承重（不透明使出价在结构上密封而无须 hash-commit/zk，认证溯源靠出生记录与 INIT 绑定，不可变历史使承诺不可撤回，历史派生状态使竞拍人集合与赢家都是 A 日志的 fold，确定性重放使任何方可复核结果）。

第8节按行给出与 Smalltalk、Self、EVM、Akka Persistence、Datomic、Clinger、Spritely Goblins、Nock/Urbit 的逐性质对照表（K=内核级、U=用户级、—=不具备），Send 内核是唯一六项全 K 的行；同时逐节详述各方 divergences（如 Goblins 溯源与历史派生状态仅为用户级；Akka sender 可由调用方指定；EVM 合约存储对外部可读且溯源靠 DELEGATECALL 约定；Datomic 无调用者概念且向读者暴露事实）。
AI.result: 主要结论如下。（1）架构可行性：存在一个极小内核（仅 s-表达式 + send + 事务 + ephemeral/persistent 区分），可使六项结构属性同时以内核级成立——§8 对照表中 Send 内核是唯一六格全 K 的一行，而现有系统各自至少一项为 U 或不具备。（2）形式化结果：Theorem 1（确定性重放）、Theorem 2（读取约束：跨对象状态只能经显式 send 路径触达）、Theorem 3（模 abort-cohort 信号的非泄漏）、Proposition 4（共同参与者的提交/中止信号不可移除，除非放弃原子性）；Corollary 明确不透明"只在读接口处成立"。（3）信任分层：内核忠实下六项对任意程序成立；操作者忠实（提交/排序/读三条件）下不透明对所有程序成立，操作者是唯一能读全 K 的实体；操作者对抗下内核不提供解答，需 Viaduct 式密码学编译器，其标签格由对象身份结构诱导（身份即机密性标签，send 分派诱导标签流），并附两项编译义务：中止必须与私密值不相关、竞拍程序必须是出价的交换函数（动态分配情形留作未来工作）。（4）委托链实验（Case Study 1）表明问责性的唯一承重点就是目标形状的分类：ephemeral 委托保留委托方身份（无中介的问责），persistent 委托引入新主体（代理以自身身份行事）。（5）密封拍卖（Case Study 2）在操作者忠实前提下实现结构性密封：无需 hash-commit/reveal 与 zk-proof，原子提交使选择性撤标不可能，且操作者"读"不受保护而"写"受确定性重放可检测性约束（诚实但受审计的操作者保证）。（6）实例化可用但代价高：ℕ + 六个纯内建 + 五条指令足以表达通用计算（Church 编码或 atom/pair+BRANCH 区分），但每个分支点约 18 条指令、每个消息 O(|history|) 的朴素代价，需状态注解/检查点编译才能摊薄为 O(1)；顺序分配使身份模式不透明降为用户级（哈希分配可恢复）。论文自陈这是"架构可能性演示"，尚非实用系统：表层语言、动态分配下的密码学组合、生产工程（性能刻画、编译、调试工具）均为开放方向；核内资源计量缺失（非终止程序会挂死内核，需 gas 式计量等确定性机制以保全重放/复制保证），而"资源有界执行"明确不是内核级性质。
AI.conclusion: 论文的结论是"一个基础 + 显式承诺"：把分散在 RPC、能力 ACL、事务协调器、事件日志与 vat 边界中的六项协调性质，收拢到一个 send 内核里并使其成为内核级（而非用户级）保证；核心贡献是接口统一（调用者只用一个动词，内核做六路结构分类）与"状态即历史"的严格化（append-only 日志 + 事务 + 位置 3 的日志访问）。作者明确划出边界并承认代价：放弃能力衰减与撤销（改由用户级门控对象承担）、放弃内建资源计量、放弃读-写并行（冲突图为稠密的仅写冲突，共享对象成瓶颈）、放弃跨分片/跨域的溯源与原子性、放弃不透明对敌对操作者的保证（改由密码学编译器承担）、放弃 Smalltalk 的 instVarAt:/become:/一等续延等需直接读写他对象状态的能力。总体判断：这是一个形式化清晰、自我约束严格、把"信任假设"显式化的架构可行性论证，而非可直接部署的系统；其价值在于提供了一份可编译目标规范（源语言编译到内核、密码学编译器以之为不透明/原子/可重放验证的规格）与一个把"内核级 vs 用户级"作为可比较坐标的分析框架。

title: AI Policy, Disclosure, and Human in the Loop: How Are Contribution Guidelines Adapting to GenAI?
summary: Generative AI (GenAI) has recently transformed software development. Due to the ease of generating code, open source projects are experiencing a growth in contributions. To address the rise of GenAI, open source projects have begun implementing policies for AI usage in contributions. However, the extent to which open source specifies whether AI-assisted contributions are allowed or prohibited, along with the best practices for contributors, remains unclear. This paper provides an initial empirical study to explore how open source projects are adapting to GenAI contributions. We analyzed 1,000 popular GitHub repositories and identified 118 AI policies for contributors.
